```text
568: @Composable
569: private fun ExerciseDialog(
570:     dayId: Long,
571:     existing: ExerciseEntity?,
572:     onDismiss: () -> Unit,
573:     onSave: (ExerciseEntity) -> Unit,
574:     onDelete: (() -> Unit)?,
575: ) {
576:     var name by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.name ?: "") }
577:     var sets by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.setCount?.toString() ?: "4") }
578:     var rest by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.restSeconds?.toString() ?: "90") }
579:     var weight by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.weightKg?.let { formatWeight(it) } ?: "20") }
580:     var reps by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.reps?.toString() ?: "10") }
581:     var error by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
582: 
583:     Dialog(onDismissRequest = onDismiss) {
584:         Surface(
585:             shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp),
586:             color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
587:         ) {
588:             Column(
589:                 Modifier
590:                     .padding(20.dp)
591:                     .imePadding()
592:                     .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
593:             ) {
594:                 Text(
595:                     if (existing == null) "添加动作" else "编辑动作",
596:                     style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall,
597:                 )
598:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(14.dp))
599:                 KeyboardGuardTextField(
600:                     value = name,
601:                     onValueChange = { name = it },
602:                     label = { Text("动作名称（如 卧推）") },
603:                     singleLine = true,
604:                 )
605:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
606:                 Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
607:                     KeyboardGuardTextField(
608:                         value = sets,
609:                         onValueChange = { sets = it.filter(Char::isDigit).take(2) },
610:                         label = { Text("组数") },
611:                         singleLine = true,
612:                         modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
613:                         keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
614:                     )
615:                     KeyboardGuardTextField(
616:                         value = rest,
617:                         onValueChange = { rest = it.filter(Char::isDigit).take(3) },
618:                         label = { Text("休息（秒）") },
619:                         singleLine = true,
620:                         modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
621:                         keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
622:                     )
623:                 }
624:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
625:                 Text(
626:                     "重量和次数分开设置，统一用于这个动作的每组",
627:                     style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
628:                     color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
629:                 )
630:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
631:                 Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
632:                     KeyboardGuardTextField(
633:                         value = weight,
634:                         onValueChange = { input ->
635:                             weight = input.filter { it.isDigit() || it == '.' }.take(5)
636:                         },
637:                         label = { Text("重量（kg）") },
638:                         singleLine = true,
639:                         modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
640:                         keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Decimal),
641:                     )
642:                     KeyboardGuardTextField(

645:                         label = { Text("每组次数") },
646:                         singleLine = true,
647:                         modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
648:                         keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
649:                     )
650:                 }
651:                 error?.let {
652:                     Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
653:                     Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = DangerRed)
654:                 }
655:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
656:                 Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
657:                     if (onDelete != null) {
658:                         TextButton(
659:                             onClick = onDelete,
660:                             colors = ButtonDefaults.textButtonColors(contentColor = DangerRed),
661:                         ) { Text("删除") }
662:                     }
663:                     Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
664:                     TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text("取消") }
665:                     Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
666:                     Button(
667:                         onClick = {
668:                             val setCount = sets.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
669:                             val restSeconds = rest.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
670:                             val weightKg = weight.toFloatOrNull() ?: -1f
671:                             val repsCount = reps.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
672:                             when {
673:                                 name.isBlank() -> error = "请填写动作名称"
674:                                 setCount !in 1..20 -> error = "组数请填 1~20"
675:                                 restSeconds !in 0..600 -> error = "休息请填 0~600 秒"
676:                                 weightKg < 0f || weightKg > 1000f -> error = "请填写合理的重量"
677:                                 repsCount !in 1..999 -> error = "次数请填 1~999"
678:                                 else -> onSave(
679:                                     ExerciseEntity(
680:                                         id = existing?.id ?: 0L,
681:                                         dayId = dayId,
682:                                         orderIndex = existing?.orderIndex ?: 0,
683:                                         name = name.trim(),
684:                                         setCount = setCount,
685:                                         restSeconds = restSeconds,
686:                                         weightKg = weightKg,
687:                                         reps = repsCount,
688:                                     )
689:                                 )
690:                             }
691:                         },
692:                         shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
693:                     ) { Text("保存") }
694:                 }
695:             }
696:         }
697:     }
698: }

701:     if (value == value.toInt().toFloat()) value.toInt().toString()
702:     else String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", value)
```

```text
5: /**
6:  * 训练状态相关的纯逻辑（不依赖 Android / Room），方便单元测试。
7:  * 「第n天」只是计划编号，不代表日期先后，也不限制训练顺序。
8:  */
9: object TrainingLogic {
10: 
11:     fun toggleSet(doneIndexes: Set<Int>, index: Int): Set<Int> =
12:         if (index in doneIndexes) doneIndexes - index else doneIndexes + index
13: 
14:     fun allSetsDone(doneIndexes: Set<Int>, totalSets: Int): Boolean =
15:         totalSets > 0 && doneIndexes.size >= totalSets
16: 
17:     fun dayTitle(dayIndex: Int): String = "循环第${dayIndex}天"
18: 
19:     fun completedLabel(dayIndex: Int): String = "循环第${dayIndex}天已练完"
20: 
21:     /** 容量分开显示：重量「60 kg」 */
22:     fun weightLabel(weightKg: Float): String =
23:         if (weightKg == weightKg.toInt().toFloat()) {
24:             "${weightKg.toInt()} kg"
25:         } else {
26:             String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f kg", weightKg)
27:         }
28: 
29:     /** 容量分开显示：次数「8 次」 */
30:     fun repsLabel(reps: Int): String = "$reps 次"
31: 
32:     fun restLabel(seconds: Int): String = when {
33:         seconds <= 0 -> "无休息"
34:         seconds < 60 -> "${seconds}秒"
35:         seconds % 60 == 0 -> "${seconds / 60}分钟"
36:         else -> "${seconds / 60}分${seconds % 60}秒"
37:     }
38: 
39:     /** 一组方块上的组号文案 */
```

````text
callId: call_8b995b1edff14315a8691ba5e5c00ac9
isError: false
<path>D:\Projects\APPdevelopment\curious-training-aid\提交包\README.md</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>
1: # 好奇训练 · CuriousTrainingAid
2: 
3: 一款**单机、免注册、离线优先**的健身执行辅助 Android App：把「今天练什么、每组多重、组间歇多久、今天吃了多少」放进同一个入口。
4: 
5: - 作品名：好奇训练（CuriousTrainingAid）
6: - 队伍：5 队 · 我爱练腿队
7: - 赛道：校园生活
8: - 现场关键词：专注、信息获取、日程安排
9: 
10: ---
11: 
12: ## 一、解决什么问题
13: 
14: 校园健身常见三个断点：
15: 
16: 1. **练的时候被打断**：组间休息靠记时或看手机，一低头就刷走；切到别的 App 或锁屏后不知道还剩几秒。
17: 2. **记的时候太麻烦**：商业健身 App 普遍要求注册、登录、云同步、订阅，记一次饮食要跳好几层；拍照算热量往往要付费额度。
18: 3. **信息分散**：训练计划在备忘录、休息计时用系统计时器、饮食靠猜，事后无法回看当天是否吃够。
19: 
20: 本作品的取舍是**只做「执行」这一段**，并且做到不联网也能完整用：
21: 
22: - 训练页：按「循环第 n 天」组织，**任何一天都能直接练**，不绑定日期、不做顺序锁；每组点一下即完成，完成一组自动开始该动作设定的休息倒计时，锁屏、切后台、熄屏都在通知栏继续走。
23: - 饮食页：按天记录三餐 + 加餐，用「总消耗 / 摄入」两条同刻度条 + 500 kcal 参考虚线直观看出差距，再配三大营养素柱状图。
24: - 拍照识别（可选）：填入自己的 AI Key 后，拍一张餐盘照片，自动给出食物、份量、热量和三大营养素，**确认后**才入账，可逐项修改。
25: - 全部数据只存在本机 Room 数据库，卸载即消失；`allowBackup=false`，不参与云备份。
26: 
27: ## 二、主要功能
28: 
29: ### 训练
30: 
31: - 自定义循环：添加/删除训练日（至少保留 1 天），训练日可**再次点击顶部按钮命名**（如「练胸日」），清空则恢复「第 n 天」。
32: - 动作：名称、组数（1–20）、休息秒数（0–600）、**重量与次数分开设置、分开保存**，统一作用于该动作每组。
33: - 组块：点一下变黑为完成，再点取消；每组完成状态持久化。
34: - 休息计时：前台服务 + 通知栏倒计时 + 应用内横条；结束震动 + 铃声响 6 秒；「跳过」会同时结束计时并移除通知。
35: - 整日完成：每个训练日有明确的「完成」按钮，完成后显示「循环第 n 天已练完 ✓」/「<自定义名>已练完」，可撤销。
36: 
37: ### 饮食
38: 
39: - 每日总消耗 = Mifflin-St Jeor 基础代谢 + 手填活动代谢；资料未保存时不显示伪造数值。
40: - 摄入 = 当日所有记录之和；两色条共用同一 kcal 刻度，竖虚线在 `max(消耗, 摄入) − 500` 处。
41: - 差值文案明确写为「消耗摄入差为：N 千卡（消耗 − 摄入）」，摄入更多时为负数。
42: - 蛋白质 / 碳水 / 脂肪三根柱状图；三餐 + 加餐（有记录才出现）；可展开、编辑、删除。
43: - 手动录入，或拍照/相册 → AI 识别 → 结果确认页 → 入账（标记「估算」）。
44: - 跨过午夜回到前台自动切到新的一天。
45: 
46: ### 设置
47: 
48: - 个人资料（性别、年龄、身高、体重、活动代谢）。
49: - AI 配置：Base URL（默认 DeepSeek 官方地址）、模型名（默认 `deepseek-flash`）、API Key（普通文本输入，便于粘贴）。
50: - 「测试连接」：`GET /models` 校验 Key 与模型名，并检查该模型是否声明图片输入能力。
51: 
52: ## 三、必要环境
53: 
54: | 项目 | 要求 |
55: | --- | --- |
56: | 构建 | JDK 17+（开发机使用 JBR 21）、Android SDK Platform 34、Build-Tools 34.0.0 |
57: | 构建工具 | Gradle 8.7（仓库自带 wrapper，无需单独安装） |
58: | 运行 | Android 8.0（API 26）及以上真机或模拟器 |
59: | 可选 | DeepSeek（或任意 OpenAI 兼容）API Key，仅「拍照识别」需要 |
60: 
61: ## 四、运行方法
62: 
63: ```powershell
64: # 1. 构建调试包 + 跑单元测试（Windows）
65: .\gradlew.bat :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug
66: 
67: # 2. 构建正式包（用本机 debug 证书签名，便于自己与朋友直接安装）
68: .\gradlew.bat :app:assembleRelease
69: # 产物：app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
70: 
71: # 3. 安装到设备（需开启 USB 调试）
72: adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
73: ```
74: 
75: 说明：
76: 
77: - 仓库自带 Gradle Wrapper（`gradlew` / `gradlew.bat`），首次构建需联网下载 Gradle 与依赖。
78: - `local.properties` 未入库，需自行配置 `sdk.dir=<Android SDK 路径>`，或设置 `ANDROID_HOME`。
79: - 正式包使用本机调试证书签名，仅用于个人/朋友安装与现场演示；未上架应用商店。
80: - 中文界面为硬编码文案，未做多语言。
81: 
82: ## 五、如何现场演示
83: 
84: 演示全程**不需要联网**（只有 AI 识别一步需要 Key，可提前配置好）：
85: 
86: 1. **打开 App**：首页即训练页，已带一个「循环第1天」。
87: 2. **加一天并命名**：点「添加一天」→ 点顶部「第2天」选中它 → **再点一次**同名按钮 → 输入「练胸日」→ 保存。顶部按钮变成「练胸日」。
88: 3. **建动作**：点「添加动作」→ 名称「卧推」、组数 4、休息 90 秒、重量 60、次数 8 → 保存。卡片显示「4 组 · 1分30秒」「重量 60 kg」「次数 8 次」。
89: 4. **完成一组看计时**：点第 1 个组块 → 变黑，出现「休息中 · 剩余 xx 秒」横条，同时通知栏出现倒计时。**按 Home 键或锁屏**，计时继续；回到 App 可点「跳过」，通知同步消失。
90: 5. **点「完成」**：显示「练胸日已练完 ✓」，可撤销；杀进程重开仍在（数据持久化）。
91: 6. **饮食页**：切到「饮食」→ 显示消耗/摄入双条与三根营养素柱。
92:    - 首次演示先到「设置」填资料（男/23/175/70/活动 300）→ 保存 → 回饮食页，总消耗立即有值。
93:    - 点「添加早餐食物」→ 手动录入「包子 100g 230 kcal」→ 确认，热量条与营养素柱同步变化。
94:    - 点差异文案可看到「消耗摄入差为：N 千卡（消耗 − 摄入）」。
95: 7. **AI 识别（可选）**：设置里填好 Key 并「测试连接」通过 → 饮食页拍照/相册 → 识别结果确认页可改份量 → 确认入账。
96: 8. **换主题/动画**：训练↔饮食切换、进入设置均有过渡动画；整体为黑白健身房风格，饮食数据条使用低饱和矿物色。
97: 
98: ## 六、目录结构
99: 
100: ```
101: 源码/
102: ├── app/                     Android 应用模块
103: │   ├── src/main/java/com/haoqi/training/
104: │   │   ├── MainActivity.kt          底部页签、设置页过渡、权限
105: │   │   ├── ui/training/             训练页 + ViewModel
106: │   │   ├── ui/diet/                 饮食页 + ViewModel + 拍照流程
107: │   │   ├── ui/settings/             设置页 + ViewModel
108: │   │   ├── ui/charts/               热量双条、营养素柱状图（Compose Canvas）
109: │   │   ├── timer/                   休息计时前台服务 + 通知
110: │   │   ├── ai/                      DeepSeek 客户端、结果解析、图片压缩
111: │   │   ├── data/                    Room 实体/DAO/仓库、SharedPreferences 配置
112: │   │   ├── domain/                  纯逻辑：BMR、热量差值、组完成、剩余秒数
113: │   │   └── di/AppContainer.kt       手动依赖容器
114: │   ├── src/test/                    28 个 JVM 单元测试
115: │   └── schemas/                     Room 导出 schema（含历史版本，供迁移校验）
116: ├── docs/                    需求说明书、测试清单、版本变更与问题记录
117: ├── scripts/                 图标生成、模拟器启动、UI 冒烟脚本
118: ├── gradle/ gradlew gradlew.bat      Gradle Wrapper
119: └── 素材/                    图标原图
120: ```
121: 
122: ## 七、隐私与安全
````

13: /** AI 识别出的一条食物（全部为估算值） */
14: data class FoodDraft(

16:     val portion: String,

23: /** 可读的 AI 错误，直接展示给用户 */
24: class AiException(message: String) : Exception(message)

26: /**
27:  * DeepSeek（OpenAI 兼容协议）客户端：
28:  *  - testConnection：GET /models 校验 Key、模型名，并检查模型是否支持图片输入
29:  *  - analyzeFood：图片 + 文字 → 食物营养估算（deepseek-flash 支持图像理解）
30:  *
31:  * 参考官方文档：
32:  *  - https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/vision

35:  * 识别时关闭思考模式（thinking disabled），否则思维链会占用 max_tokens、延迟也更高。
36:  */
37: class DeepSeekClient {
38: 
39:     suspend fun testConnection(config: ApiConfig): Result<String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
40:         resultOf {
41:             requireConfigured(config)
42:             val models = try {
43:                 fetchModels(config)
44:             } catch (e: AiException) {
45:                 // 某些 OpenAI 兼容服务没有 /models，退化成一次最小对话请求
46:                 if (e.message?.contains("HTTP 404") == true) {
47:                     pingChat(config)
48:                     return@resultOf "连接成功：${config.model} 可以用（该地址不支持模型列表，已用最小请求验证）"
49:                 }
50:                 throw e
51:             }
52:             val target = models.firstOrNull { it.id == config.model }
53:                 ?: throw AiException(
54:                     "Key 有效，但模型列表里没有「${config.model}」。可用模型：" +
55:                         models.joinToString("、") { it.id }.ifBlank { "（空）" }
56:                 )
57:             val vision = if (target.supportsImage) "支持看图" else "不支持看图，无法识别食物"
58:             "连接成功：${target.id}（$vision），Key 有效"
59:         }
60:     }
61: 
62:     suspend fun analyzeFood(
63:         config: ApiConfig,
64:         imageBase64: String,
65:         mime: String,
66:     ): Result<List<FoodDraft>> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
67:         resultOf {
68:             requireConfigured(config)
69:             val body = JSONObject().apply {
70:                 put("model", config.model)
71:                 // 官方文档：思考模式默认开启；识别任务关掉更快、更省 token
72:                 put("thinking", JSONObject().put("type", "disabled"))
73:                 put("max_tokens", 1600)
74:                 put(
75:                     "messages",
76:                     JSONArray().put(
77:                         JSONObject().apply {
78:                             put("role", "user")
79:                             put(
80:                                 "content",
81:                                 JSONArray().apply {
82:                                     put(
83:                                         JSONObject().apply {
84:                                             put("type", "text")
85:                                             put("text", PROMPT)
86:                                         }
87:                                     )
88:                                     put(
89:                                         JSONObject().apply {
90:                                             put("type", "image_url")
91:                                             put(
92:                                                 "image_url",
93:                                                 JSONObject().apply {
94:                                                     put("url", "data:$mime;base64,$imageBase64")
95:                                                 }
96:                                             )
97:                                         }
98:                                     )
99:                                 }
100:                             )
101:                         }
102:                     )
103:                 )
104:             }
105:             parseFoods(postChatCompletions(config, body))
106:         }
107:     }
108:     private fun requireConfigured(config: ApiConfig) {
109:         if (!config.isConfigured) throw AiException("请先在设置里填写 API Key")
110:     }
111: 
112:     private data class ModelInfo(
113:         val id: String,
114:         val supportsImage: Boolean,
115:     )
116: 
117:     private fun fetchModels(config: ApiConfig): List<ModelInfo> {
118:         val endpoint = config.baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/models"
119:         val connection = openConnection(config, endpoint)
120:         try {
121:             val code = connection.responseCode
122:             val text = readBody(connection, code)
123:             if (code !in 200..299) throw AiException(httpErrorMessage(code, text))
124:             val data = JSONObject(text).optJSONArray("data") ?: JSONArray()
125:             return (0 until data.length()).mapNotNull { index ->
126:                 val item = data.optJSONObject(index) ?: return@mapNotNull null
127:                 val id = item.optString("id").trim()
128:                 if (id.isBlank()) return@mapNotNull null
129:                 val modalities = item.optJSONArray("input_modalities")
130:                 val supportsImage = modalities != null &&
131:                     (0 until modalities.length()).any { modalities.optString(it) == "image" }
132:                 ModelInfo(id = id, supportsImage = supportsImage)
133:             }
134:         } finally {
135:             connection.disconnect()
136:         }
137:     }
138: 
139:     /** 没有 /models 的兼容服务：发一条 16 token 的最小对话，验证地址与 Key。 */
140:     private fun pingChat(config: ApiConfig) {
141:         val body = JSONObject().apply {
142:             put("model", config.model)
143:             put("thinking", JSONObject().put("type", "disabled"))
144:             put("max_tokens", 16)
145:             put(
146:                 "messages",
147:                 JSONArray().put(
148:                     JSONObject().put("role", "user").put("content", "ping")
149:                 )
150:             )
151:         }
152:         postChatCompletions(config, body)
153:     }
154: 
155:     private fun openConnection(config: ApiConfig, endpoint: String): HttpURLConnection =
156:         (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
157:             requestMethod = "GET"
158:             connectTimeout = 15_000
159:             readTimeout = 15_000
160:             setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
161:             setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer [凭据已脱敏]
162:         }
163: 
164:     private fun readBody(connection: HttpURLConnection, code: Int): String {
165:         val stream: InputStream? = if (code in 200..299) connection.inputStream else connection.errorStream
166:         return stream?.bufferedReader()?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
167:     }
168: 
169:     private fun postChatCompletions(config: ApiConfig, body: JSONObject): String {
170:         val endpoint = config.baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
171:         val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
172:             requestMethod = "POST"
173:             connectTimeout = 15_000
174:             readTimeout = 120_000
175:             doOutput = true
176:             setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
177:             setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer [凭据已脱敏]
178:         }
179:         try {
180:             connection.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toString().toByteArray()) }
181:             val code = connection.responseCode
182:             val text = readBody(connection, code)
183:             if (code !in 200..299) throw AiException(httpErrorMessage(code, text))
184: 
185:             val json = try {
186:                 JSONObject(text)
187:             } catch (e: Exception) {
188:                 throw AiException("服务器返回的不是 JSON，请检查接口地址")
189:             }
190:             val choices = json.optJSONArray("choices")
191:                 ?: throw AiException("模型返回格式异常（没有 choices）")
192:             if (choices.length() == 0) throw AiException("模型没有返回内容")
193:             val choice = choices.getJSONObject(0)
194:             val message = choice.optJSONObject("message")
195:             val content = message?.optString("content").orEmpty()
196:             if (content.isNotBlank()) return content
197:             val finishReason = choice.optString("finish_reason")
198:             throw AiException(
199:                 if (finishReason == "length") "模型输出被截断，请重试或换更小的图"
200:                 else "模型返回内容为空（finish_reason=$finishReason）"
201:             )
202:         } finally {
203:             connection.disconnect()
204:         }
205:     }
206: 
207:     private fun httpErrorMessage(code: Int, body: String): String {
208:         // 服务端错误文本可能包含请求片段，截断后再展示
209:         val snippet = body.take(120).replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ")
210:         return when (code) {
211:             401, 403 -> "API Key 无效或无权限（HTTP $code）"
212:             404 -> "接口地址或模型名不存在（HTTP 404）"
213:             413 -> "图片太大，服务器拒绝（HTTP 413）"
214:             422 -> "请求参数不被接受（HTTP 422）：$snippet"
215:             429 -> "请求太频繁或额度不足（HTTP 429）"
216:             in 500..599 -> "服务器繁忙（HTTP $code），稍后重试"
217:             else -> "请求失败（HTTP $code）：$snippet"
218:         }
219:     }
220: 
221:     /** 从模型输出里抠出 JSON（可能带 ``` 围栏或解释文字），交给纯函数解析器。 */
222:     private fun parseFoods(content: String): List<FoodDraft> = FoodJsonParser.parse(content)
223: 
224:     private fun Throwable.toAiException(): AiException = when (this) {
225:         is AiException -> this
226:         is java.net.SocketTimeoutException -> AiException("网络超时，请检查网络后重试")
227:         is java.net.UnknownHostException -> AiException("无法连接服务器，请检查网络和接口地址")
228:         is javax.net.ssl.SSLException -> AiException("HTTPS 连接失败，请检查接口地址")
229:         else -> AiException("识别失败：${message ?: "未知错误"}")
230:     }
231: 
232:     private inline fun <T> resultOf(block: () -> T): Result<T> = try {
233:         Result.success(block())
234:     } catch (e: CancellationException) {
235:         throw e
236:     } catch (e: Throwable) {
237:         Result.failure(e.toAiException())
238:     }

245:             数值单位：热量 kcal、蛋白质/脂肪/碳水为克。识别不到食物时输出 {"foods":[]}。

```text
89: @Composable
90: fun DietScreen(
91:     state: DietUiState,
92:     apiConfig: ApiConfig,
93:     onAddFood: (MealType, String, String, Float, Float, Float, Float, Boolean) -> Unit,
94:     onDeleteEntry: (FoodEntryEntity) -> Unit,
95:     onUpdateEntry: (FoodEntryEntity) -> Unit,
96:     onAnalyzePhoto: (ByteArray, String) -> Unit,
97:     onConfirmDrafts: (MealType, List<FoodDraft>) -> Unit,
98:     onClearAiState: () -> Unit,
99:     onOpenSettings: () -> Unit,
100:     modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
101: ) {
102:     val context = LocalContext.current
103:     val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
104: 
105:     var addMeal by remember { mutableStateOf<MealType?>(null) }
106:     var manualMeal by remember { mutableStateOf<MealType?>(null) }
107:     var editingEntry by remember { mutableStateOf<FoodEntryEntity?>(null) }
108:     var pendingMeal by remember { mutableStateOf(MealType.LUNCH) }
109:     var cameraUri by remember { mutableStateOf<Uri?>(null) }
110: 
111:     fun compressAndAnalyze(uri: Uri) {
112:         scope.launch {
113:             val bytes = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { ImageCompressor.loadJpegBytes(context, uri) }
114:             if (bytes != null) {
115:                 // 压缩后一律是 JPEG，MIME 跟着实际内容走
116:                 onAnalyzePhoto(bytes, "image/jpeg")
117:             }
118:         }
119:     }
120: 
121:     val pickImage = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
122:         ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia()
123:     ) { uri -> uri?.let { compressAndAnalyze(it) } }
124: 
125:     val takePicture = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
126:         ActivityResultContracts.TakePicture()
127:     ) { success -> if (success) cameraUri?.let { compressAndAnalyze(it) } }
128: 
129:     Column(
130:         modifier = modifier
131:             .fillMaxSize()
132:             .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
133:             .padding(bottom = 24.dp),
134:     ) {
135:         Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
136:             ScreenTitle("饮食")
137:             Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
138:             IconButton(onClick = onOpenSettings) {
139:                 Icon(Icons.Filled.Settings, contentDescription = "设置")
140:             }
141:             Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
142:         }
143: 
144:         CalorieGroupCard(state)
145: 
146:         SectionLabel("营养摄入")
147:         GroupCard {
148:             MacroBars(
149:                 protein = state.totalProtein,
150:                 carbs = state.totalCarbs,
151:                 fat = state.totalFat,
152:             )
153:         }
154: 
155:         MealType.entries.forEach { meal ->
156:             val entries = state.entriesOf(meal)
157:             if (meal != MealType.SNACK || entries.isNotEmpty()) {
158:                 MealSection(
159:                     meal = meal,
160:                     entries = entries,
161:                     onAdd = { addMeal = meal },
162:                     onDelete = onDeleteEntry,
163:                     onEdit = { editingEntry = it },
164:                 )
165:             }
166:         }
167: 
168:         if (state.entries.isEmpty()) {
169:             Text(
170:                 "还没有记录。先拍照识别，或手动录入一餐。",
171:                 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
172:                 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
173:                 modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
174:             )
175:         }
176:     }
177: 
178:     addMeal?.let { meal ->
179:         AddFoodChoiceDialog(
180:             meal = meal,
181:             aiConfigured = apiConfig.isConfigured,
182:             onDismiss = { addMeal = null },
183:             onPickPhoto = {
184:                 addMeal = null
185:                 pendingMeal = meal
186:                 pickImage.launch(PickVisualMediaRequest(ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia.ImageOnly))
187:             },
188:             onTakePhoto = {
189:                 addMeal = null
190:                 pendingMeal = meal
191:                 val dir = File(context.cacheDir, "camera").apply { mkdirs() }
192:                 val file = File.createTempFile("food_", ".jpg", dir)
193:                 val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.fileprovider", file)
194:                 cameraUri = uri
195:                 takePicture.launch(uri)
196:             },
197:             onManual = {
198:                 addMeal = null
199:                 manualMeal = meal
200:             },
201:         )
202:     }
203: 
204:     manualMeal?.let { meal ->
205:         ManualFoodDialog(
206:             meal = meal,
207:             onDismiss = { manualMeal = null },
208:             onSave = { draft ->
209:                 onAddFood(meal, draft.name, draft.portion, draft.kcal, draft.protein, draft.fat, draft.carbs, false)
210:                 manualMeal = null
211:             },
212:         )
213:     }
214: 
215:     editingEntry?.let { entry ->
216:         ManualFoodDialog(
217:             meal = MealType.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == entry.meal } ?: MealType.LUNCH,
218:             isEditing = true,
219:             initial = FoodDraft(entry.name, entry.portion, entry.kcal, entry.protein, entry.fat, entry.carbs),
220:             onDismiss = { editingEntry = null },
221:             onSave = { draft ->
222:                 onUpdateEntry(
223:                     entry.copy(
224:                         name = draft.name,
225:                         portion = draft.portion,
226:                         kcal = draft.kcal,
227:                         protein = draft.protein,
228:                         fat = draft.fat,
229:                         carbs = draft.carbs,
230:                     )
231:                 )
232:                 editingEntry = null
233:             },
234:         )
235:     }
236: 
237:     when (val ai = state.aiState) {
238:         is AiState.Analyzing -> AnalyzingDialog(onCancel = onClearAiState)
239:         is AiState.Failed -> AiErrorDialog(message = ai.message, onDismiss = onClearAiState)
240:         is AiState.Result -> FoodDraftDialog(
241:             initialMeal = pendingMeal,
242:             drafts = ai.drafts,
243:             onConfirm = { meal, drafts -> onConfirmDrafts(meal, drafts) },
244:             onDismiss = onClearAiState,
245:         )
246:         AiState.Idle -> Unit
247:     }
248: }

250: @Composable
251: private fun CalorieGroupCard(state: DietUiState) {
252:     GroupCard {
253:         Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
254:             Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
255:                 Text("今日热量", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge)
256:                 Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
257:                     Dot(BarExpenditure)
258:                     Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
259:                     Text(
260:                         "总消耗 ${state.expenditureKcal.toInt()} kcal",
261:                         style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
262:                         color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
263:                     )
264:                     Spacer(Modifier.width(14.dp))
265:                     Dot(BarIntake)
266:                     Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
267:                     Text(
268:                         "摄入 ${state.totalKcal.toInt()} kcal",
269:                         style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
270:                         color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
271:                     )
272:                 }
273:             }
274:         }
275:         Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
276:         CalorieBars(
277:             expenditureKcal = state.expenditureKcal,
278:             intakeKcal = state.totalKcal,
279:         )
280:         Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
281:         val delta = state.expenditureKcal - state.totalKcal
282:         val differenceText = "消耗摄入差为：${delta.toInt()} 千卡（消耗 − 摄入）"
283:         val overTarget = CalorieChartMath.isAtLeastTarget(state.expenditureKcal, state.totalKcal)
284:         val statusText = when {
285:             state.expenditureKcal <= 0f -> "先在设置里填个人资料和活动代谢，才会有总消耗"
286:             overTarget -> "已达到 500 千卡目标\n$differenceText"
287:             else -> "未达到 500 千卡目标\n$differenceText"
288:         }
289:         Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
290:             Box(
291:                 Modifier
292:                     .size(10.dp)
293:                     .clip(CircleShape)
294:                     .background(BarDashedLine),
295:             )
296:             Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
297:             Text(
298:                 "竖虚线 = 差距 500 kcal 的位置",
299:                 style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
300:                 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
301:             )
302:         }
303:         Text(
304:             statusText,
305:             style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
306:             color = if (overTarget) SuccessGreen else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
307:             modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 4.dp),
308:         )
309:     }
310: }

317: @Composable
318: private fun MealSection(
319:     meal: MealType,
320:     entries: List<FoodEntryEntity>,
321:     onAdd: () -> Unit,
322:     onDelete: (FoodEntryEntity) -> Unit,
323:     onEdit: (FoodEntryEntity) -> Unit,
324: ) {
325:     var expandedId by remember { mutableStateOf<Long?>(null) }
326:     SectionLabel(meal.label)
327:     GroupCard(contentPadding = androidx.compose.foundation.layout.PaddingValues(0.dp)) {
328:         entries.forEach { entry ->
329:             FoodRow(
330:                 entry = entry,
331:                 expanded = expandedId == entry.id,
332:                 onClick = { expandedId = if (expandedId == entry.id) null else entry.id },
333:                 onEdit = { onEdit(entry) },
334:                 onDelete = { onDelete(entry) },
335:             )
336:         }
337:         Row(
338:             Modifier
339:                 .fillMaxWidth()
340:                 .pressScaleClickable(onClick = onAdd)
341:                 .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
342:             verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
343:         ) {
344:             Icon(
345:                 Icons.Filled.Add,
346:                 contentDescription = null,
347:                 modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp),
348:                 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
349:             )
350:             Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
351:             Text(
352:                 "添加${meal.label}食物",
353:                 style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge,
354:                 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
355:             )
356:         }
357:     }
358: }

361: private fun FoodRow(

386:                                 style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
387:                                 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
388:                                 modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp),

390:                         }
391:                     }
392:                 }
393:                 Text(
394:                     "${entry.portion} · ${entry.kcal.toInt()} kcal",

402:                     contentDescription = "编辑",
403:                     tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
404:                     modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp),
405:                 )
406:             }
407:             IconButton(onClick = onDelete, modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)) {
408:                 Icon(
409:                     Icons.Filled.Delete,
410:                     contentDescription = "删除",
411:                     tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
412:                     modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp),
413:                 )
414:             }
415:             Icon(
416:                 if (expanded) Icons.Filled.ExpandLess else Icons.Filled.ExpandMore,
417:                 contentDescription = null,
418:                 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
419:                 modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp),
420:             )
421:         }
422:         AnimatedVisibility(visible = expanded) {
423:             Row(
424:                 Modifier
425:                     .fillMaxWidth()
426:                     .padding(top = 8.dp),
427:                 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
428:             ) {
429:                 MacroTag("蛋白质", entry.protein, MacroProtein)
430:                 MacroTag("碳水", entry.carbs, MacroCarbs)
431:                 MacroTag("脂肪", entry.fat, MacroFat)
432:             }
433:         }
434:     }
435: }

555: @Composable
556: private fun ManualFoodDialog(
557:     meal: MealType,
558:     onDismiss: () -> Unit,
559:     onSave: (FoodDraft) -> Unit,
560:     initial: FoodDraft? = null,
561:     isEditing: Boolean = false,
562: ) {
563:     var name by remember { mutableStateOf(initial?.name ?: "") }
564:     var portion by remember { mutableStateOf(initial?.portion ?: "1 份") }
565:     var kcal by remember { mutableStateOf(initial?.kcal?.let { formatNumber(it) } ?: "") }
566:     var protein by remember { mutableStateOf(initial?.protein?.let { formatNumber(it) } ?: "") }
567:     var fat by remember { mutableStateOf(initial?.fat?.let { formatNumber(it) } ?: "") }
568:     var carbs by remember { mutableStateOf(initial?.carbs?.let { formatNumber(it) } ?: "") }
569:     var error by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
570: 
571:     Dialog(onDismissRequest = onDismiss) {
572:         Surface(shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface) {
573:             Column(
574:                 Modifier
575:                     .padding(20.dp)
576:                     .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
577:             ) {
578:                 Text(
579:                     if (isEditing) "编辑食物 · ${meal.label}" else "手动录入 · ${meal.label}",
580:                     style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall,
581:                 )
582:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
583:                 KeyboardGuardTextField(
584:                     value = name,
585:                     onValueChange = { name = it },
586:                     label = { Text("食物名称") },
587:                     singleLine = true,
588:                 )
589:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
590:                 KeyboardGuardTextField(
591:                     value = portion,
592:                     onValueChange = { portion = it },
593:                     label = { Text("份量（如 150g）") },
594:                     singleLine = true,
595:                 )
596:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
```

```text
1: """Render the supplied artwork as a bottom-right adaptive-icon foreground.
2: 
3: Launchers only reveal the central part of the 108dp adaptive-icon layer
4: (~72-84dp depending on vendor), so the composition is pre-shrunk about the
5: layer centre. On a phone that crops the layer, the result then matches the
6: intended design instead of appearing zoomed-in.
7: """
8: from pathlib import Path
9: from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
10: 
11: root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
12: source = root / '微信图片_20261018163238_274_46.png'
13: art = Image.open(source).convert('RGBA')
14: 
15: # White-on-black artwork: luminance is the effective alpha mask.
16: luma = art.convert('L')
17: bounds = luma.point(lambda v: 255 if v > 32 else 0).getbbox()
18: assert bounds, 'no artwork'
19: 
20: CANVAS = 432                     # 108dp layer rendered at 4x
21: subject = luma.crop(bounds)
22: 
23: # Design pass: figure anchored bottom-right, jeans bleeding past the edges.
24: design_height = round(CANVAS * 0.92)
25: design_width = round(subject.width * design_height / subject.height)
26: scaled = subject.resize((design_width, design_height), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
27: design = Image.new('L', (CANVAS, CANVAS), 0)
28: design.paste(scaled, (CANVAS - design_width + round(CANVAS * 0.02),
29:                       CANVAS - design_height + round(CANVAS * 0.02)))
30: 
31: # Crop compensation: measured on the user's HyperOS launcher screenshot, the
32: # layer is shown at ~1.25x, which clipped the head against the icon top edge.
33: CROP_ZOOM = 1.25
34: inner = round(CANVAS / CROP_ZOOM)
35: compensated = design.resize((inner, inner), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
36: offset = (CANVAS - inner) // 2
37: 
38: alpha = Image.new('L', (CANVAS, CANVAS), 0)
39: alpha.paste(compensated, (offset, offset))
40: # Keep the frame edges inked so the mask rounding never reveals a seam.
41: ImageDraw.Draw(alpha).rectangle((0, 0, CANVAS - 1, 2), fill=0)
42: foreground = Image.new('RGBA', (CANVAS, CANVAS), 'white')
43: foreground.putalpha(alpha)
44: 
45: out = root / 'app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/launcher_artwork.png'
46: out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
47: foreground.save(out)
48: 
49: # Previews: what a full-layer launcher shows, and what a cropping launcher shows.
50: def tile_of(image):
51:     tile = Image.new('RGBA', (CANVAS, CANVAS), (0, 0, 0, 255))
52:     tile.alpha_composite(image)
53:     return tile
54: 
55: def masked(tile, radius_factor):
56:     mask = Image.new('L', (CANVAS, CANVAS), 0)
57:     ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle(
58:         (0, 0, CANVAS - 1, CANVAS - 1), radius=round(CANVAS * radius_factor), fill=255)
59:     out_tile = Image.new('RGBA', (CANVAS, CANVAS), (0, 0, 0, 0))
60:     out_tile.paste(tile, (0, 0), mask)
61:     return out_tile
62: 
63: full = tile_of(foreground)
64: # Simulated vendor view: show only the central 1/CROP_ZOOM, enlarged back to icon size.
65: crop_box = (offset, offset, offset + inner, offset + inner)
66: cropped = full.crop(crop_box).resize((CANVAS, CANVAS), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
67: 
68: tiles = [('layer', masked(full, 0.26)), ('vendor crop', masked(cropped, 0.26))]
69: pad, gap = 24, 12
70: preview = Image.new('RGBA', (len(tiles) * CANVAS + (len(tiles) + 1) * gap,
71:                               CANVAS + 2 * pad), (245, 245, 245, 255))
72: for i, (_, tile) in enumerate(tiles):

74: preview_path = root / 'docs/图标预览-右下贴边.png'
75: preview_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
76: preview.save(preview_path)
```

```text
68: @OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)

139:     fun analyzePhoto(imageBytes: ByteArray, mime: String) {
140:         val config = apiConfigStore.config.value

156:     }
```

```text
31: import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
32: 
33: /** 供界面展示的休息状态（null = 没有在休息）。 */
34: data class RestTimerState(
35:     val label: String,
36:     val remainingSeconds: Int,
37:     val totalSeconds: Int,
38: )
39: 
40: /**
41:  * 组间休息倒计时前台服务：
42:  *  - 前台服务 + 通知栏倒计时，锁屏/切后台继续跑
43:  *  - 计时结束震动 + 响铃（走闹钟音量通道），并弹「休息结束」通知
44:  *  - 通知栏可直接「跳过休息」
45:  */
46: class RestTimerService : Service() {
47: 
48:     private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
49:     private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null
50:     private var alertRingtone: Ringtone? = null
51:     private var endAtElapsed = 0L
52:     private var label = "休息"
53:     private var totalSeconds = 0
54:     private var lastShownSeconds = -1
55: 
56:     private val tickRunnable = object : Runnable {
57:         override fun run() {
58:             val remainingMs = endAtElapsed - SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
59:             if (remainingMs <= 0L) {
60:                 finishRest()
61:                 return
62:             }
63:             // 向上取整，避免显示 0 秒却还要等 1 秒才结束
64:             val remaining = RestTimerMath.remainingSeconds(remainingMs)
65:             if (remaining != lastShownSeconds) {
66:                 lastShownSeconds = remaining
67:                 _state.value = RestTimerState(label, remaining, totalSeconds)
68:                 notifyOngoing(remaining)
69:             }
70:             handler.postDelayed(this, 200L)
71:         }
72:     }
73: 
74:     override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null
75: 
76:     override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
77:         when (intent?.action) {
78:             ACTION_START -> {
79:                 val seconds = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_SECONDS, 60).coerceIn(0, MAX_SECONDS)
80:                 label = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_LABEL) ?: "休息"
81:                 if (seconds <= 0) {
82:                     stopSelf()
83:                     return START_NOT_STICKY
84:                 }
85:                 totalSeconds = seconds
86:                 endAtElapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + seconds * 1000L
87:                 lastShownSeconds = -1
88:                 stopAlertSound()
89:                 acquireWakeLock(seconds)
90:                 // 清掉上一轮（可能还在响铃/等待退出）的所有回调
91:                 handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
92:                 startForegroundSafe(buildOngoing(seconds))
93:                 _state.value = RestTimerState(label, seconds, seconds)
94:                 handler.post(tickRunnable)
95:             }
96: 
97:             ACTION_SKIP -> {
98:                 handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
99:                 stopAlertSound()
100:                 releaseWakeLock()
101:                 _state.value = null
102:                 ServiceCompat.stopForeground(this, ServiceCompat.STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
103:                 (getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager).cancel(NOTIF_ID)
104:                 stopSelf()
105:             }
106:         }
107:         return START_NOT_STICKY
108:     }
109: 
110:     private fun finishRest() {
111:         handler.removeCallbacks(tickRunnable)
112:         releaseWakeLock()
113:         _state.value = null
114:         vibrateAlert()
115:         playAlertSound()
116:         // 保持前台状态 6 秒，避免系统回收服务导致铃声中断；
117:         // 结束后 detach 通知（留在通知栏），再退出服务。
118:         startForegroundSafe(buildFinished())
119:         handler.postDelayed({
120:             stopForegroundQuietly()
121:             stopSelf()
122:         }, ALERT_SOUND_MS + 500L)
123:     }
124: 
125:     /** Android 14 起显式传前台服务类型，避免特殊用途类型未生效被系统杀。 */
126:     private fun startForegroundSafe(notification: Notification) {
127:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE) {
128:             ServiceCompat.startForeground(
129:                 this,
130:                 NOTIF_ID,
131:                 notification,
132:                 ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE,
133:             )
134:         } else {
135:             startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notification)
136:         }
137:     }
138: 
139:     private fun notifyOngoing(remaining: Int) {
140:         val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
141:         manager.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildOngoing(remaining))
142:     }
143: 
144:     private fun buildOngoing(remaining: Int): Notification {
145:         val skipIntent = PendingIntent.getService(
146:             this,
147:             REQUEST_SKIP,
148:             Intent(this, RestTimerService::class.java).setAction(ACTION_SKIP),
149:             PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
150:         )
151:         return NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
152:             .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_notification)
153:             .setContentTitle("休息中 · $label")
154:             .setContentText("剩余 ${formatDuration(remaining)}")
155:             .setOngoing(true)
156:             .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
157:             .setSilent(true)
158:             .setContentIntent(openAppIntent())
159:             .addAction(0, "跳过休息", skipIntent)
160:             .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_STOPWATCH)
161:             .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_LOW)
162:             .build()
163:     }
164: 
165:     private fun buildFinished(): Notification =
166:         NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
167:             .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_notification)
168:             .setContentTitle("休息结束，开始下一组")
169:             .setContentText(label)
170:             .setAutoCancel(true)
171:             .setContentIntent(openAppIntent())
172:             .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_REMINDER)
173:             .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_HIGH)
174:             .build()
175: 
176:     private fun openAppIntent(): PendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
177:         this,
178:         REQUEST_OPEN,
179:         Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
180:             flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
181:         },
182:         PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
183:     )
184: 
185:     private fun acquireWakeLock(seconds: Int) {
186:         releaseWakeLock()
187:         val powerManager = getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as PowerManager
188:         wakeLock = powerManager.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "CuriousTraining:RestTimer").apply {
189:             setReferenceCounted(false)
190:             acquire((seconds + 60) * 1000L)
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:     private fun releaseWakeLock() {
195:         wakeLock?.let { if (it.isHeld) it.release() }
196:         wakeLock = null
197:     }
198: 
199:     private fun vibrateAlert() {
200:         val vibrator = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
201:             (getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_MANAGER_SERVICE) as VibratorManager).defaultVibrator
202:         } else {
203:             @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
204:             getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as Vibrator
205:         }
206:         val pattern = longArrayOf(0, 500, 200, 500, 200, 500, 200, 500)
207:         vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createWaveform(pattern, -1))
208:     }
209: 
210:     private fun playAlertSound() {
211:         stopAlertSound()
212:         val alarmUri = RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_ALARM)
213:             ?: RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_NOTIFICATION)
214:             ?: return
215:         alertRingtone = RingtoneManager.getRingtone(this, alarmUri)?.apply {
216:             audioAttributes = AudioAttributes.Builder()
217:                 .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM)
218:                 .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
219:                 .build()
220:             play()
221:         }
222:         handler.postDelayed({ stopAlertSound() }, ALERT_SOUND_MS)
223:     }
224: 
225:     private fun stopAlertSound() {
226:         alertRingtone?.stop()
227:         alertRingtone = null
228:     }
229:

231:         ServiceCompat.stopForeground(this, ServiceCompat.STOP_FOREGROUND_DETACH)
232:     }
233: 
234:     override fun onDestroy() {
235:         handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
236:         _state.value = null
237:         stopAlertSound()
238:         releaseWakeLock()
239:         super.onDestroy()
240:     }
241: 
242:     companion object {
243:         private val _state = MutableStateFlow<RestTimerState?>(null)
244: 
245:         /** 界面用它显示「休息中 · 剩余 xx 秒」，不用轮询服务。 */
246:         val state: StateFlow<RestTimerState?> = _state.asStateFlow()
247: 
248:         private const val CHANNEL_ID = "rest_timer_v2"
249:         private const val CHANNEL_NAME = "休息计时与结束提醒"
250:         private const val NOTIF_ID = 1001
251:         private const val REQUEST_SKIP = 11
252:         private const val REQUEST_OPEN = 12
253:         private const val EXTRA_SECONDS = "seconds"
254:         private const val EXTRA_LABEL = "label"
255:         private const val MAX_SECONDS = 3600

257:         const val ACTION_START = "com.haoqi.training.action.REST_START"
258:         const val ACTION_SKIP = "com.haoqi.training.action.REST_SKIP"
259: 
260:         fun start(context: Context, seconds: Int, label: String) {
261:             createChannel(context)
262:             val intent = Intent(context, RestTimerService::class.java).apply {
263:                 action = ACTION_START
264:                 putExtra(EXTRA_SECONDS, seconds)
265:                 putExtra(EXTRA_LABEL, label)
266:             }
267:             ContextCompat.startForegroundService(context, intent)
268:         }
269: 
270:         fun skip(context: Context) {
271:             context.startService(
272:                 Intent(context, RestTimerService::class.java).setAction(ACTION_SKIP)
273:             )
274:         }
275: 
276:         fun createChannel(context: Context) {
277:             val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
278:             if (manager.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID) != null) return
279:             val channel = NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, CHANNEL_NAME, NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH).apply {
280:                 description = "组间休息倒计时与结束提醒（声音由 App 自己播放）"
281:                 setSound(null, null)
282:                 enableVibration(false)
283:                 setShowBadge(true)
284:             }
285:             manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
286:         }
287: 
288:         private fun formatDuration(seconds: Int): String {
289:             val minutes = seconds / 60
290:             val secs = seconds % 60
291:             return if (minutes > 0) "${minutes}分${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}秒" else "${secs}秒"
```

```text
1: # 0.2.5 图标适配系统裁切
2: 
3: ## 问题
4: 
5: 0.2.4 把人物画满 108dp 图层的右下角。但手机桌面展示自适应图标时只露出图层中
6: 心约 1/1.25 的区域并放大，导致实际显示的人物比设计稿更大、头顶贴到图标上沿，
7: 与预览图不一致。
8: 
9: ## 做法
10: 
11: 先在 108dp 图层里画设计稿（人物贴右下、牛仔裤越界出血），再把整张设计稿按
12: 1.25 倍反向缩小、居中放回图层。这样系统裁掉外圈后放大的结果，正好等于设计稿。
13: 
14: - `CROP_ZOOM = 1.25` 来自用户小米 15 桌面截图测量：纯黑图标区域内，人物头顶与
15:   图标上沿重合，相对于设计稿 10.2% 的顶部留白，推算裁切放大倍数约 1.25。
16: - 预览图 `docs/图标预览-右下贴边.png` 左为图层原样、右为模拟系统裁切后的实际观感。
17: - 模拟裁切下主体范围为 x 34.3%–100%、y 10.9%–100%，与设计稿一致。
18: 
19: ## 取舍
20: 
21: - 桌面若**不裁切**（如部分 AOSP 启动器直接显示整层），图标会显得小一圈、底部留黑边；
22:   小米 HyperOS 属于裁切型，显示为设计稿效果。
23: - 若桌面图标形状改为**圆形**，右下角牛仔裤仍会被圆弧削掉一部分。
24: 
25: ## 验证

28: - release 构建通过；Android 14 模拟器覆盖安装后图标资源正常加载，应用冷启动正常。
29: - 小米真机观感需用户再截一张桌面图确认补偿倍数。
```

## seq 109 · 原始行 111 · 工具返回 / tool/result

时间：2026-10-18T09:17:02.335Z

````text
callId: call_38a191592d754973bbd7029764b0cdd0
isError: false
<path>D:\Projects\APPdevelopment\curious-training-aid\提交包\README.md</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>
1: # 好奇训练 · CuriousTrainingAid
2: 
3: 一款免注册、离线优先的 Android 健身执行辅助 App，把「今天练什么、每组多重、组间歇多久、今天吃了多少」放进同一个入口。训练记录、休息计时和手动饮食记录可离线使用；可选的 AI 图片识别与连接测试需要联网。
4: 
5: - 作品名：好奇训练（CuriousTrainingAid），当前源码版本 0.2.5（versionCode 8）
6: - 队伍：5 队 · 我爱练腿队
7: - 队员：董昊奇、王子岩
8: - 赛道：校园生活
9: - 现场关键词：专注、信息获取、日程安排
10: 
11: ## 一、解决什么问题
12: 
13: 校园健身时，训练安排、组间计时、饮食记录往往分散在不同入口。本作品将它们集中到训练、饮食两个页面：用组块记录完成情况，用通知辅助休息计时，用当天热量和营养素汇总辅助回看。
14: 
15: 训练日按循环组织，不绑定真实日期，也不限制必须依次完成；饮食按本地自然日记录。应用没有账号体系和云同步功能。
16: 
17: ## 二、主要功能
18: 
19: ### 训练
20: 
21: - 添加、删除训练日，至少保留一天；点击顶部未选中的训练日切换，点击已经选中的训练日可重命名，留空恢复「第 n 天」。也可左右滑动切换。
22: - 动作可设置名称、组数（1–20）、休息秒数（0–600）、重量和每组次数。重量、次数分别保存，统一作用于该动作的每组。
23: - 点击组块切换完成状态并保存；从未完成变为完成且休息时间大于 0 时启动倒计时。再次点击取消组完成状态不会自动停止已经开始的计时，应使用「跳过」。
24: - 前台服务提供应用内计时条和通知倒计时；新计时会替换旧计时。结束时触发震动、播放系统闹钟铃声（约 6 秒后停止）并保留结束通知；「跳过」停止计时并移除通知。
25: - 整日「完成」状态需手动标记，可撤销；它与各组完成状态分别保存。
26: 
27: ### 饮食
28: 
29: - 总消耗估算 = Mifflin-St Jeor 基础代谢 + 手填活动代谢；未保存个人资料时总消耗显示 0，并提示先填写资料。
30: - 摄入为当日记录之和，消耗和摄入共用同一 kcal 刻度。参考虚线位于 `max(0, max(消耗, 摄入) − 500)`；页面直接显示「消耗摄入差为：N 千卡（消耗 − 摄入）」。
31: - 蛋白质、碳水、脂肪各有汇总柱；早餐、午餐、晚餐支持手动录入，食物记录可展开、编辑、删除。
32: - AI 流程已实现为拍照/相册选图 → 上传识别 → 结果编辑 → 确认入账，记录标记「估算」。**尚未用真实有效 Key 验证完整图片识别链路，不能据此保证 DeepSeek 或其他服务可用。**
33: - AI 结果确认页可选择加餐；加餐区仅在已有加餐记录时出现，当前没有独立的首次手动添加加餐入口。
34: - 跨过午夜后，在应用重新回到前台时切到新的一天；没有历史日期浏览入口，也没有持续停留前台时的午夜刷新定时器。
35: 
36: ### 设置与 AI 配置
37: 
38: - 个人资料：性别、年龄、身高、体重、活动代谢，点击「保存资料」后用于计算。
39: - AI 配置：Base URL、模型名、API Key。源码默认地址为 `https://api.deepseek.com`、模型名为 `deepseek-flash`；这些是默认配置，不代表已实测的服务能力。Key 输入框为明文。
40: - 「测试连接」先请求 `GET /models`，核对模型名并读取 `input_modalities` 中的图片能力声明；字段缺失也会显示不支持看图。若服务返回 HTTP 404，则退化为一次最小文本对话请求，该请求可能计费。
41: - **连接成功不等于图片识别成功**：测试未实际发送图片，文本回退也不能验证视觉能力。兼容服务还需接受当前图片消息格式及 `thinking` 等请求参数，不能保证任意 OpenAI 兼容接口都可使用。
42: 
43: ## 三、必要环境
44: 
45: | 项目 | 要求 |
46: | --- | --- |
47: | 构建 | JDK 17+（需与 Gradle 8.7 兼容）、Android SDK Platform 34、Build-Tools 34.0.0 |
48: | 构建工具 | Gradle 8.7，源码自带 Wrapper，无需另装 Gradle |
49: | 运行 | Android 8.0（API 26）及以上真机或模拟器 |
50: | USB 安装 | Android SDK Platform-Tools / adb，以及设备 USB 调试权限 |
51: | 可选 AI | 网络、有效 API Key，以及实际支持当前图片请求的服务与模型 |
52: | 可选图标重新生成 | Python 3、Pillow；常规 Android 构建直接使用现有图标资源，无需运行图标脚本 |
53: 
54: ## 四、构建与安装
55: 
56: 在解压后的源码根目录执行，先设置 `JAVA_HOME` 指向自己的 JDK，并通过 `local.properties` 的 `sdk.dir` 或环境变量 `ANDROID_HOME` 配置自己的 Android SDK 路径。
57: 
58: ```powershell
59: # 单元测试与调试包
60: .\gradlew.bat :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug
61: 
62: # Release 包（当前构建配置使用本机 debug 签名）
63: .\gradlew.bat :app:assembleRelease
64: # 产物：app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
65: 
66: # 首次安装；覆盖安装仅适用于与设备已有应用签名一致的 APK
67: adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
68: ```
69: 
70: 首次构建需联网下载 Gradle 和依赖。源码不分发开发机的 `local.properties` 和本地签名私钥。当前 debug/release 都使用构建机器自己的 debug 证书；**另一台机器重新构建通常会使用不同证书，无法直接覆盖提交包中现有 APK 安装的应用**，`adb install -r` 不能绕过签名检查。可在另一设备或干净模拟器安装自建包；若选择先卸载旧包再安装，旧包本地记录和设置会丢失。
71: 
72: ## 五、现场演示流程
73: 
74: 基础演示不需要联网。首次启动如弹出通知权限请求，应允许通知，并检查系统通知与闹钟音量设置。下面数据仅用于演示。
75: 
76: 1. **训练日**：首次打开训练页，默认有「第1天」。点击「添加一天」，新一天会自动选中；点击已选中的「第2天」打开命名弹窗，输入「练胸日」并保存。
77: 2. **动作**：点击「添加动作」，输入名称「卧推」、组数 4、休息 15 秒、重量 60 kg、次数 8，保存后查看动作卡片。
78: 3. **计时**：点击未完成的第一个组块，观察组块变黑、应用内休息条和通知。切到后台或锁屏查看通知，再返回；可等待到点查看结束提醒，也可在下一组计时期间点击「跳过」验证通知清除。设备通知和后台策略可能影响展示与提醒。
79: 4. **完成与持久化**：点击训练日「完成」，查看「练胸日已练完」与「撤销」。结束计时后关闭并重新打开应用，回到该训练日检查动作和完成状态。
80: 5. **饮食资料**：进入设置，填写男、23 岁、175 cm、70 kg、活动代谢 300 kcal，点击「保存资料」，返回饮食页查看总消耗估算。
81: 6. **手动记餐**：点击「添加早餐食物」→「手动录入」，填「包子」、份量「100g」、热量 230、蛋白质 8、碳水 40、脂肪 4，点击「保存」。观察摄入条、营养素柱和直接显示的差值文案；点击食物行展开，再用编辑、删除按钮演示修改。营养素需要分别填写，不会由食物名称或热量自动推算。
82: 7. **可选联网识图**：仅在已有可用服务并完成现场前实测时演示。设置 AI 地址、模型、Key 并保存，测试连接后，从某一餐的添加入口选择拍照或相册。选图后会发起上传；若返回结果，核对名称、份量、热量及营养素后「确认入账」。若失败，展示错误提示并继续使用手动录入，不把连接测试结果当成识图通过证据。
83: 
84: 界面使用固定浅色主题，页面切换有过渡效果，没有换主题入口。
85: 
86: ## 六、源码结构
87: 
88: ```text
89: 源码/
90: ├── app/
91: │   ├── src/main/java/com/haoqi/training/
92: │   │   ├── MainActivity.kt          主界面、页签、设置与权限
93: │   │   ├── ui/training/             训练页与 ViewModel
94: │   │   ├── ui/diet/                 饮食页与图片入口
95: │   │   ├── ui/settings/             资料与 AI 配置
96: │   │   ├── ui/charts/               热量及营养素图表
97: │   │   ├── timer/                   休息计时前台服务
98: │   │   ├── ai/                      HTTP 客户端、结果解析、图片压缩
99: │   │   ├── data/                    Room 数据与 SharedPreferences 配置
100: │   │   ├── domain/                  热量、训练、计时等纯逻辑
101: │   │   └── di/                      依赖容器
102: │   ├── src/test/                    JVM 单元测试
103: │   └── schemas/                     Room 数据库 schema
104: ├── docs/                           需求、变更与既有验证记录
105: ├── scripts/                        图标生成及开发验证脚本
106: ├── gradle/                         Gradle Wrapper 配置与文件
107: ├── gradlew / gradlew.bat            构建入口
108: └── 微信图片_20261018163238_274_46.png  图标脚本所需原图
109: ```
110: 
111: 图标原图保留在源码根目录并保持原文件名；图标生成脚本按该路径读取，不移动到「素材」目录。开发验证脚本中的设备、SDK 或工具路径可能需要按本机环境调整。
112: 
113: ## 七、数据与隐私
114: 
115: - 训练记录、饮食记录和个人资料保存在本机 Room 数据库，当前源码没有将这些数据库记录同步到服务器的功能；API 配置另存于 App 私有 SharedPreferences。
116: - 配置 AI 后，主动拍照或选图会将压缩后的 JPEG（最长边至多 1024 px）和识别提示发送到配置的 AI 服务。**入账前确认只控制本地记录写入，不代表图片等到确认后才上传。**第三方如何保存或使用请求数据由其政策决定，本应用不能保证服务端不留存。
117: - 连接测试和图片识别都会向配置的服务发送 API Key 作为认证信息。Key 默认为空，本地存储未额外加密，输入时直接可见；配置时应使用可信的 HTTPS 服务。
118: - Manifest 设置 `allowBackup=false`，并提供排除备份/迁移的数据规则；没有应用内导出和恢复功能。卸载或清除应用数据会丢失本地记录与配置，不应把系统迁移当作数据恢复保证。
119: 
120: ## 八、验证记录与已知限制
121: 
122: 本说明依据当前源码与已有项目记录整理，不将源码检查等同于设备实测。已有版本记录包含 Android 14 模拟器的构建、覆盖安装、冷启动及部分交互验证，例如 0.2.2 的跳过通知清除与 0.2.5 的图标资源加载。源码中提供 JVM 单元测试和开发验证脚本，可按上述构建命令复核。旧版真机测试清单中的未勾选项目不是通过记录，部分旧文案也不代表当前实现。
123: 
124: - 未使用真实有效 Key 跑通完整 AI 图片识别；模型能力、接口兼容性、费用和结果质量都需要实际验证。AI 份量与营养结果是估算，不保证准确；修改份量文字不会自动按比例重算热量与营养素。
125: - 未完成物理手机上的系统性测试；锁屏长时间计时、声音、震动和各厂商后台限制不能作普遍保证。进程被终止、强制停止或设备重启后，正在运行的倒计时不会自动恢复。
126: - 每次只有一个休息计时；取消组完成标记不会停止它。自然到点保留结束提醒，主动跳过才清除通知。
127: - 图表「达到 500 千卡目标」判断采用消耗与摄入差的绝对值，摄入高于消耗 500 kcal 也会显示达到；它不是个性化减脂建议，总消耗本身也只是公式估算。
128: - 只支持一套循环计划，没有按日期记录的训练历史、多计划、账号同步和趋势统计；当天饮食有记录，但界面没有历史日期查询。首次手动加餐入口及持续前台跨午夜刷新尚未提供。
129: - 当前使用标准 Android 通知，没有接入小米 HyperOS「超级岛」。固定浅色中文界面，未做多语言；较多训练组块在窄屏上的展示仍需设备验证。
130: - 图标在不同启动器的裁切与圆形遮罩下可能有不同观感，不能保证与预览完全相同。
````

```text
44:     private fun applyExifRotation(stream: InputStream?, bitmap: Bitmap): Bitmap {
45:         if (stream == null) return bitmap
46:         val orientation = try {
47:             stream.use {
48:                 ExifInterface(it).getAttributeInt(
49:                     ExifInterface.TAG_ORIENTATION,
50:                     ExifInterface.ORIENTATION_NORMAL,
51:                 )

53:         } catch (e: Exception) {

57:         val degrees = when (orientation) {
58:             6 -> 90f // ORIENTATION_ROTATE_90
59:             3 -> 180f // ORIENTATION_ROTATE_180
60:             8 -> 270f // ORIENTATION_ROTATE_270
61:             else -> 0f
62:         }
63:         if (degrees == 0f) return bitmap
64:         val matrix = Matrix().apply { postRotate(degrees) }
65:         val rotated = Bitmap.createBitmap(bitmap, 0, 0, bitmap.width, bitmap.height, matrix, true)
66:         if (rotated !== bitmap) bitmap.recycle()
```

```text
<skill_content name="diagnosing-bugs">
<skill_resources>
Base directory for this skill: [用户目录]\.dsh\skills\diagnosing-bugs
Resolve relative paths mentioned by this skill against the base directory before using them. Load referenced resources only as needed.
</skill_resources>

<skill_instructions>
# Diagnosing Bugs

A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.

When exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.

## Redact

This skill has you show commands, outputs and captured artifacts. **Redact every secret first**: write `<REDACTED>` in its place. Build loops against env vars, so the credential stays in the environment rather than in what you show. Captured artifacts carry auth headers: quote only the lines that carry the signal.

If the redacted output is not enough to diagnose the bug, say so and ask the user.

## Phase 1: Build a feedback loop

**This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug (one that goes red on _this_ bug), you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.

Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**

### Ways to construct one, in roughly this order

1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug: unit, integration, e2e.
2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) that drives the UI and asserts on DOM/console/network.
5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.

Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.

### Tighten the loop

Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:

- Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
- Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
- Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)

A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight, a debugging superpower.

### Non-deterministic bugs

The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100脳, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not, so keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.

### When you genuinely cannot build a loop

Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a redacted captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.

### Completion criterion: a tight loop that goes red

Phase 1 is done when the loop is **tight** and **red-capable**: you can name **one command** (a script path, a test invocation, a curl) that you have **already run at least once** (show the invocation and its output, redacted), and that is:

- [ ] **Red-capable**: it drives the actual bug code path and asserts the **user's exact symptom**, so it can go red on this bug and green once fixed. Not "runs without erroring"; it must be able to _catch this specific bug_.
- [ ] **Deterministic**: same verdict every run (flaky bugs: a pinned, high reproduction rate, per above).
- [ ] **Fast**: seconds, not minutes.
- [ ] **Agent-runnable**: you can run it unattended; a human in the loop only via `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh`.

If you catch yourself reading code to build a theory before this command exists, **stop: jumping straight to a hypothesis is the exact failure this skill prevents.** No red-capable command, no Phase 2.

## Phase 2: Reproduce + minimise

Run the loop. Watch it go red as the bug appears.

Confirm:

- [ ] The loop produces the failure mode the **user** described, not a different failure that happens to be nearby. Wrong bug = wrong fix.
- [ ] The failure is reproducible across multiple runs (or, for non-deterministic bugs, reproducible at a high enough rate to debug against).
- [ ] You have captured the exact symptom (error message, wrong output, slow timing) so later phases can verify the fix actually addresses it.

### Minimise

Once it's red, shrink the repro to the **smallest scenario that still goes red**. Cut inputs, callers, config, data, and steps **one at a time**, re-running the loop after each cut, and keep only what's load-bearing for the failure.

Why bother: a minimal repro shrinks the hypothesis space in Phase 3 (fewer moving parts left to suspect) and becomes the clean regression test in Phase 5.

Done when **every remaining element is load-bearing**: removing any one of them makes the loop go green.

Do not proceed until you have reproduced **and** minimised.

## Phase 3: Hypothesise

Generate **3鈥? ranked hypotheses** before testing any of them. Single-hypothesis generation anchors on the first plausible idea.

Each hypothesis must be **falsifiable**: state the prediction it makes.

> Format: "If <X> is the cause, then <changing Y> will make the bug disappear / <changing Z> will make it worse."

If you cannot state the prediction, the hypothesis is a vibe: discard or sharpen it.

**Show the ranked list to the user before testing.** They often have domain knowledge that re-ranks instantly ("we just deployed a change to #3"), or know hypotheses they've already ruled out. Cheap checkpoint, big time saver. Don't block on it; proceed with your ranking if the user is AFK.

## Phase 4: Instrument

Each probe must map to a specific prediction from Phase 3. **Change one variable at a time.**

Tool preference:

1. **Debugger / REPL inspection** if the env supports it. One breakpoint beats ten logs.
2. **Targeted logs** at the boundaries that distinguish hypotheses.
3. Never "log everything and grep".

**Tag every debug log** with a unique prefix, e.g. `[DEBUG-a4f2]`. Cleanup at the end becomes a single grep. Untagged logs survive; tagged logs die.

**Perf branch.** For performance regressions, logs are usually wrong. Instead: establish a baseline measurement (timing harness, `performance.now()`, profiler, query plan), then bisect. Measure first, fix second.

## Phase 5: Fix + regression test

Write the regression test **before the fix**, but only if there is a **correct seam** for it.

A correct seam is one where the test exercises the **real bug pattern** as it occurs at the call site. If the only available seam is too shallow (single-caller test when the bug needs multiple callers, unit test that can't replicate the chain that triggered the bug), a regression test there gives false confidence.

**If no correct seam exists, that itself is the finding.** Note it. The codebase architecture is preventing the bug from being locked down. Flag this for the next phase.

If a correct seam exists:

1. Turn the minimised repro into a failing test at that seam.
2. Watch it fail.
3. Apply the fix.
4. Watch it pass.
5. Re-run the Phase 1 feedback loop against the original (un-minimised) scenario.

## Phase 6: Cleanup

Required before declaring done:

- [ ] Original repro no longer reproduces (re-run the Phase 1 loop)
- [ ] Regression test passes (or absence of seam is documented)
- [ ] All `[DEBUG-...]` instrumentation removed (`grep` the prefix)
- [ ] Throwaway prototypes deleted (or moved to a clearly-marked debug location)
- [ ] The hypothesis that turned out correct is stated in the commit / PR message, so the next debugger learns
</skill_instructions>
</skill_content>
```

````text
Interview the user relentlessly until you reach a shared understanding. Map this as a **design tree**: every decision branches into the decisions that hang off it.

Work the tree in **rounds**. The **frontier** is every decision whose prerequisites are already settled: the questions you can ask _now_ without guessing at answers you haven't heard yet. Ask the whole frontier in one round: number each question and give your recommended answer. Then wait for the user's answers before the next round.

Format a round like so:

Each round the user answers reshapes the tree: settled decisions push the frontier outward and unblock questions that depended on them. Recompute the frontier and ask the next round. A question whose answer depends on another question still open in this round belongs to a _later_ round, not this one.

Finding _facts_ is your job, never the user's. When a frontier question needs a fact from the environment (filesystem, tools, etc.), dispatch a sub-agent to find it; don't ask the user for anything you could look up yourself. Don't block on it: a running exploration is an unsettled prerequisite, so only the questions downstream of it wait for the sub-agent to report; ask the rest of the frontier now. The _decisions_ are the user's: put each to them and wait.

The session is done when the frontier is empty: every branch of the design tree visited, nothing left silently assumed. Do not act on it until the user confirms you have reached a shared understanding.
````

## seq 184 · 原始行 186 · 助手可见输出 / assistant/message

时间：2026-10-18T05:29:18.885Z

```text
可以。先做需求访谈，**这一轮不建项目、不写代码**。旅行项目的外观、动画和踩坑记录已安排只读调研，后续会结合证据讨论，不凭空猜你喜欢什么。

你的初步结构我理解为：**训练执行页 + 饮食记录页**。先确认会影响整体设计的第一轮问题，具体按钮、动画和边界行为放到后续轮次。

❓ **Q1 — 谁使用这个软件？**
先做你自己使用的私人辅助工具，还是准备给其他人安装、未来公开发布？这会影响账号、数据同步、模型密钥和隐私设计。

➡️ **建议：第一版先满足你个人使用，但不把实现写死成只能一个人用。**

---

❓ **Q2 — 你说的“轻量”，最看重什么？**
是功能少、打开快、安装包小、界面简洁，还是不用注册、不依赖网络？可以多选，但请排出最重要的两项。

➡️ **建议：优先“训练时操作少、打开快”，其次“不注册也能使用”；不为了安装包极小牺牲体验。**

---

❓ **Q3 — 训练循环按什么推进？**
例如“三练一休”的四天循环：
- **按日历推进**：今天没练，明天仍进入下一天。
- **按完成推进**：今天没练，下次继续这一天。
- **手动选择**：只提供循环模板，由你自己选当天计划。

➡️ **建议：按完成推进，允许手动跳过、补练；休息日明确显示，避免漏练导致整个周期错位。**

---

❓ **Q4 — 重量和次数是统一设定，还是逐组设定？**
例如卧推四组，你想记录“四组均为 40kg × 10次”，还是允许“40×12、45×10、45×8、40×10”？实际训练时，是否还要修改实际重量和次数，保留与计划的区别？

➡️ **建议：支持逐组设置，用一键复制减少输入；训练时记录实际值，不覆盖原计划。**

---

❓ **Q5 — 热量进度条到底表达什么？**
你写的“已消耗多少热量”，是指：
- 今天**已经吃进去**多少，占每日热量预算的比例；
- 今天运动**消耗了**多少，占运动目标的比例。

这两个含义相反，必须先区分。

➡️ **建议：饮食页显示“已摄入 / 每日目标”，旁边显示剩余；超过目标也明确显示，而不是卡在 100%。你是否还希望有减脂、维持、增肌三种目标？**

---

❓ **Q6 — 你愿意如何使用食物识别？**
拍照后直接记账，还是先展示识别出的食物、估计份量和营养，让你确认修改后再记账？一张照片通常不能可靠确定重量、用油和隐藏配料。

➡️ **建议：识别 → 确认食物及份量 → 入账，并提供纯手动录入；将结果标为估算，不伪装成精确测量。**

---

❓ **Q7 — 能否接受把食物照片上传给模型服务？**
接受云端识别，还是要求照片完全留在手机？这是隐私和实现成本的核心选择；“内置模型功能”不一定意味着“模型在手机本地运行”。

➡️ **建议：第一版使用云端识别，但仅在你主动点击时上传，明确告知；训练计划、计时和已有饮食记录离线可用。**

---

你可以直接按 **Q1～Q7** 回答，接受建议就写“按建议”。视觉和动画方向等旅行项目调研回来后再问，避免让你重复解释。
```

<content>
1: # 好奇旅行 · HaoQiTravel
2: 
3: 单机版 AI 旅行规划 App：填好时间与城市，AI 自动生成完整行程（景点 / 酒店 / 饭店 / 城际交通），一键导入后可在高德地图上查看与导航、按出发时间自动提醒。
4: 
5: ## 技术栈
6: 
7: - Kotlin + Jetpack Compose (Material 3)
8: - 高德地图（3D 地图 + 地理编码）
9: - Room（本地数据库，纯离线，数据只存本机）
10: - 豆包 · 火山方舟 API（AI 行程生成：联网返回**真实**车次/航班/酒店，再照抄进行程，杜绝编造车次）
11: 
12: ## 功能
13: 
14: - **AI 规划**：填出发地 + 每天城市 + 特殊要求，AI 结合口味/预算/节奏/出行档次偏好生成行程，可反复对话修改到满意；
15: - **联网搜索**：两步法——先联网核实真实车票/酒店清单，再让规划模型只从清单里照抄；查不到就写「建议/待定」，绝不编造；
16: - **行程页**：按天 + 时段（上午/午餐/下午/晚餐/晚上）排布，可拖动调整、手动加地点；
17: - **车票**：录入真实车票后按发车时间提前提醒（高铁/火车 45 分钟、航班 2 小时、大巴 30 分钟）；
18: - **地图**：地点落点、点标记导航；
19: - **预约提醒**：需预约/购票的景点自动标记，到预约日提醒。
20: 
21: ## 安装
22: 
23: 到 [Releases](../../releases) 下载最新 `app-release.apk`，直接安装（需允许"安装未知来源应用"）。
24: 
25: ## 自己构建
26: 
27: 1. 申请 [高德开放平台](https://lbs.amap.com/) Key（Android 平台，填应用包名 `com.haoqi.travel` 和你本机的调试 SHA1）；
28: 2. 在项目根目录 `local.properties` 里加一行（该文件不进 git）：
29:    ```
30:    amap.key=你的高德Key
31:    ```
32: 3. 申请 [火山方舟](https://console.volcengine.com/ark) 的 API Key（App 里默认用豆包，Key 只存在本机）：
33:    - 在方舟控制台创建 API Key；在「开通管理」里启用 **联网内容插件**（否则联网搜索不可用）。
34:    - 模型名称填方舟的模型 ID（如 `doubao-seed-2-0-lite-260428`）；若提示模型不存在/未开通，就在方舟控制台开通该模型，或创建一个「推理接入点」，把 `ep-xxxxx` 填进 App；
35: 4. 装好后在 App「更多 → AI 生成设置」里选服务商、填 Key 保存；
36: 5. `./gradlew :app:assembleRelease` 构建。
37: 
38: ## 📘 申请豆包 API 完整流程（火山方舟接入说明书）
39: 
40: > 本节同时适用于：App 首次使用前的「申请 API Key + 开通模型 + 创建推理接入点」，以及任何接入报错的排查。以下步骤按 2026 年方舟控制台编写，若菜单位置有变，可用控制台右上角搜索直达功能页。
41: 
42: ### 一、注册并开通方舟服务（10 分钟）
43: 
44: 1. **注册火山引擎账号**：访问 <https://www.volcengine.com> 注册（手机号即可），完成**实名认证**（个人实名即可，控制台「账号中心 → 实名认证」）。
45: 2. **进入火山方舟**：打开 <https://console.volcengine.com/ark>，确认右上角区域是 **「华北2（北京）」**（豆包模型默认在此区域）。
46: 3. 首次进入按页面引导**开通方舟服务**（同意服务协议，一般即时生效，免费开通、按量后付费）。
47: 
48: ### 二、创建 API Key（第 1 个 Key）
49: 
50: 1. 方舟控制台左侧菜单 → **「API Key 管理」**。
51: 2. 点 **「创建 API Key」**，复制生成的 Key（形如一串较长的字符）。
52: 3. **保存好 Key**：关闭页面后不再显示完整值，只能重新创建。Key 只填进本机 App，不要贴到网上或提交到代码仓库。
53: 
54: ### 三、开通模型服务（关键！不做这步会报 ModelNotOpen）
55: 
56: 1. 左侧菜单 → **「开通管理」**（有的版本叫「模型广场/开通管理」）。
57: 2. 在 **「模型服务」** 列表里搜索 **`doubao-seed-2-0-lite`**（本 App 默认模型，全名 `doubao-seed-2-0-lite-260428`），点 **「开通」/「立即开通」**，按提示确认。
58:    - 开通是免费的，只代表「允许你的账号调用」，实际费用按调用量后付。
59: 3. **没搜到？** 换一个能搜到的豆包 2.x 模型开通（如 `doubao-seed-2-0-mini`），或在控制台搜不到时走第 5 节的「推理接入点」路线。
60: 
61: ### 四、开通「联网内容插件」（联网查真实车票/酒店必需）
62: 
63: 1. 同一页「开通管理」切到 **「插件」** 分类。
64: 2. 找到 **「联网内容插件（Web Search）」**，点 **「开通」**（免费）。
65: 3. 不开通的话，App 里「联网查真实车次/航班」会失败，只能退回普通模式（车票给建议、酒店待定）。
66: 
67: 官方说明：[Web Search（联网内容插件）- 火山方舟](https://ark.volcengine.com/region:cn-beijing/docs/82379/1756990?lang=zh)
68: 
69: ### 五、（推荐可选）创建「推理接入点」ep-xxx
70: 
71: 用**模型 ID 直连**在第 3 步开通后即可工作；若仍报「模型不存在」或想固定一个模型，可创建推理接入点：
72: 
73: 1. 左侧菜单 → **「在线推理」→「创建推理接入点」**。
74: 2. 模型选择 **豆包 Seed 2.0 Lite**（或你已开通的模型），按需设置后创建。
75: 3. 创建完成会得到一个 **`ep-xxxxxxxx`** 形式的接入点 ID——把它填进 App 的「模型名称 / 推理接入点」框即可（用 ep 不会再报 ModelNotOpen）。
76: 
77: ### 六、填进 App 并测试
78: 
79: 1. App「更多 → AI 生成设置」：
80:    - 服务商：**豆包(火山方舟)**；
81:    - 接口地址：保持默认 `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3`；
82:    - **模型名称 / 推理接入点**：填模型 ID `doubao-seed-2-0-lite-260428`，或你创建的 `ep-xxx`；
83:    - API Key：填第 2 节复制的 Key；
84:    - 打开 **「联网查真实车次/航班」** → 保存。
85: 2. 到「AI 规划」页生成一次行程。成功后聊天区会出现「已联网核实到真实车票/酒店」，生成完可在「车票」页与 12306 核对。
86: 
87: ### 七、常见报错对照表
88: 
89: | 现象 | 原因 | 解决 |
90: | --- | --- | --- |
91: | `ModelNotOpen` / 「账号未开通模型」 | 模型服务没开通（第 3 节） | 控制台「开通管理 → 模型服务」开通该模型，或改用推理接入点 ep-xxx |
92: | 「模型不存在 / model not found」(404) | 模型 ID 填错或该版本已下线（如 1.6 系列） | 填控制台显示的准确模型 ID，或直接填 ep-xxx |
93: | 「联网核实未成功…已改用普通模式」 | ①「联网内容插件」未开通；②联网较慢超时 | 开通插件后重试；联网首步需 1～3 分钟，请耐心等它跑完 |
94: | `MissingParameter: tools.function.parameter` | 用 chat/completions 传 web_search 工具（旧版问题，本 App 已改走 Responses API，新版不会再遇到） | 更新到 v2.0 版本 |
95: | 一直转圈 / 超时 | 网络慢或服务繁忙 | 稍后重试；App 已自动放宽超时并重试一次 |
96: 
97: ### 八、费用提示
98: 
99: 方舟按调用量**后付费**，模型价格以控制台「开通管理 / 价格页」为准；常见模型有免费额度活动（以控制台活动为准）。个人规划旅行用量很小，费用通常可忽略。
100: 
101: ## 隐私
102: 
103: - 所有行程数据**只存本机**（Room 数据库），不上传任何服务器；
104: - 只有在你点「AI 规划」时，把行程需求发给火山方舟官方 API 用于生成，不存你的旅行数据；
105: - API Key 只保存在本机 SharedPreferences。
106: 
107: ## 目录
108: 
109: - `app/src/main/java/com/haoqi/travel/data/` — 数据层（Room、网络、AI 客户端、解析器）
110: - `app/src/main/java/com/haoqi/travel/ui/` — Compose 界面
111: - `app/src/test/` — 单元测试（解析器 / AI 清洗 / 提示词）

(End of file - total 111 lines)
</content>
