````text
旅行项目调研完成（只读，未改动）。先给结论，再进入下一轮提问。

## 好奇旅行项目的可复用经验

**技术栈**（[README.md](<D:/Projects/TravelPlanAPP/README.md#L7-L10>)、[需求说明书.md](<D:/Projects/TravelPlanAPP/docs/需求说明书.md#L25-L35>)）：Kotlin + Jetpack Compose (Material 3) + Room 纯本地数据库，minSdk 26，Gradle 8.7 + AGP 8.5.2 + Kotlin 2.0.21，APK 放 GitHub Releases 直接安装。

**你的产品习惯**（[需求说明书.md](<D:/Projects/TravelPlanAPP/docs/需求说明书.md#L22-L23>)）：有明确的“v2 暂不做”清单，砍功能很果断；无账号无云端、数据只存本机、中文界面。

**踩过的坑**（[README.md](<D:/Projects/TravelPlanAPP/README.md#L87-L95>)）：
- 模型服务未开通/模型 ID 填错导致 `ModelNotOpen`、404 → 健身 App 的 AI 设置页要做“测试连接”按钮和清晰的报错提示
- 网络慢超时 → 自动放宽超时并重试一次
- API Key 只存本机（[README.md](<D:/Projects/TravelPlanAPP/README.md#L101-L105>)）

以上经验我会直接带入健身项目。另外：`D:\Projects\APPdevelopment` 下还没有健身项目文件夹，尚未创建。

---

## 第二轮提问

❓ **Q8 — 技术栈是否完全复用好奇旅行的方案？**
Kotlin + Compose M3 + Room + 本地存数据 + APK 直接安装。好处：你已熟悉、审美经验可直接照搬、无新依赖。

➡️ **建议：完全复用。**

---

❓ **Q9 — 文件夹名与 App 显示名？**
工作区约定（AGENTS.md）要求文件夹用小写 kebab-case，所以文件夹是 `curious-training-aid`。App 中文名想叫什么？“好奇旅行”对应健身可以叫“好奇训练”。

➡️ **建议：文件夹 `curious-training-aid`，App 中文名「好奇训练」，代号保留 CuriousTrainingAid。**

---

❓ **Q10 — 训练数据要不要保留历史？**
选项：a) 只保留当前循环状态（第几天、每组是否完成），练完一轮自动清零开始下一轮；b) 保留历史记录（哪天练了什么、重量次数），可以回看上次用的重量。

➡️ **建议：b 的最小版——自动记录每次训练，只提供“上次重量”参考，不做统计图表。**

---

❓ **Q11 — 休息计时是否要在锁屏/切后台后继续响铃震动？**
如果只在 App 内计时，你休息时锁屏看手机，计时结束就不会提醒。可靠方案是用前台服务 + 通知，锁屏也能震动响铃。

➡️ **建议：要。用前台服务，计时中通知栏显示倒计时，结束时震动+响铃，即使锁屏。**

---

❓ **Q12 — 饮食页营养列表显示哪些项？**
你写了“蛋白质 n g、n 千卡竖向排列”。每种食物显示：热量、蛋白质、脂肪、碳水，四项够吗？还是要更多（膳食纤维、钠、糖）？

➡️ **建议：就四项——热量、蛋白质、脂肪、碳水，符合你“功能尽可能少”的要求。**

---

❓ **Q13 — 三餐之外有加餐怎么办？**
只有早/午/晚三个固定分区，还是加一个“加餐”分区？

➡️ **建议：固定三餐 + 一个“加餐”分区，不加餐就不显示。**

---

❓ **Q14 — 基础代谢公式用 Mifflin-St Jeor 可以吗？**
即：男性 `10×体重 + 6.25×身高 − 5×年龄 + 5`，女性减 161。总消耗（灰条）= 该公式结果 + 你手动填的活动代谢，填一次长期有效，可随时改。

➡️ **建议：用这个公式。**

---

❓ **Q15 — 500kcal 虚线，我理解成这样对吗？**
两个条共用同一条横向刻度（单位 kcal），虚线画在 **较大值 − 500** 的位置，穿过上下两个条：

```
总消耗(灰) ████████████████████ 2400
                      ┊ ←虚线在1900
摄 入(蓝)  ███████████           1500
```
- 虚线落在**短条内部** → 差值还不到 500
- 虚线落在**短条末端之外** → 差值已超过 500
- 无论消耗大于摄入还是摄入大于消耗，规则一样

➡️ **建议：按这个实现。不对的话你画图给我。**

---

❓ **Q16 — AI 设置页用什么协议？**
沿用好奇旅行的思路：设置页填 **接口地址 + 模型名 + API Key**（OpenAI 兼容协议），外加一个“测试连接”按钮。这样豆包、你正在用的中转站都能接。默认服务商想预填谁？豆包（有视觉模型、你已熟悉开通流程）还是其他？

➡️ **建议：OpenAI 兼容可配置协议 + 测试按钮；默认预填火山方舟地址，模型名留空让你填视觉模型。**

---

❓ **Q17 — v1 明确不做的清单，确认一下？**
体重历史曲线、动作教学动画（你已否）、统计图表、云同步、账号系统、多计划并存（同时只保留一个训练计划）、深色模式跟随系统之外的额外主题。

➡️ **建议：全部不做；深色模式仅跟随系统。有异议现在提。**

---

可以按 **Q8～Q17** 直接回答，同意建议就写“按建议”。全部确认后我会给出完整需求共识，经你确认再开始建项目写代码。
````

```text
本页目录

# 模型 & 价格

下表所列模型价格以“百万 tokens”为单位。Token 是模型用来表示自然语言文本的的最小单位，可以是一个词、一个数字或一个标点符号等。我们将根据模型输入和输出的总 token 数进行计量计费。

* * *

## 模型细节[​](#模型细节 "模型细节的直接链接")

**

|     |     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 模型  | deepseek-flash(1) | deepseek-v4-pro |
| BASE URL (OpenAI 格式) | [https://api.deepseek.com](https://api.deepseek.com) |
| BASE URL (Anthropic 格式) | [https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic](https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic) |
| 模型版本 | DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 | DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 |
| 思考模式 | 支持非思考与思考模式（默认）  <br>切换方式详见[思考模式](/zh-cn/guides/thinking_mode) |
| 上下文长度 | 1M  |
| 输出长度 | 最大 384K |
| 功能  | [Json Output](/zh-cn/guides/json_mode) | 支持  | 支持  |
| [Tool Calls](/zh-cn/guides/tool_calls) | 支持  | 支持  |
| [Responses API](/zh-cn/guides/responses_api) | 支持  | 支持  |
| [Anthropic API](/zh-cn/guides/anthropic_api) | 支持  | 支持  |
| [对话前缀续写（Beta）](/zh-cn/guides/chat_prefix_completion) | 支持  | 支持  |
| [FIM 补全（Beta）](/zh-cn/guides/fim_completion) | 仅非思考模式支持 | 仅非思考模式支持 |
| [图像理解](/zh-cn/guides/vision) | 支持  | 不支持 |
| 价格(2) | 百万tokens输入  <br>（缓存命中） | 空闲时段 | 0.02元 | 0.15元 |
| 高峰时段 | 0.04元 | 0.30元 |
| 百万tokens输入  <br>（缓存未命中） | 空闲时段 | 1元  | 4.5元 |
| 高峰时段 | 2元  | 9.0元 |
| 百万tokens输出 | 空闲时段 | 4元  | 13.5元 |
| 高峰时段 | 8元  | 27.0元 |
| 并发限制(3) | 2500 | 500 |

**

(1) 模型名请使用 `deepseek-flash`。旧模型名 `deepseek-v4-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 仍可调用，但对应模型已下线，请求将由 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 模型提供服务，并按 Flash 价格计费。

(2) 空闲时段价格为高峰时段价格的一半。北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）9:00 - 12:00、14:00 - 18:00 为高峰时段；其余时段，包括周末及中国法定节假日全天均为空闲时段。

(3) 更多并发限制细节，请参考[限速与隔离](/zh-cn/quick_start/rate_limit)。

* * *

## 网页搜索与抓取价格[​](#网页搜索与抓取价格 "网页搜索与抓取价格的直接链接")

Search 和 Fetch 是独立的 API，按请求次数计费。

| API | 计费单位 | 价格  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Search | 每 1,000 次成功请求 | 5元  |
| Fetch | 每 1,000 次成功请求 | 5元  |

请注意，当前用户在 DeepSeek Harness/Claude Code/Codex 中使用 DeepSeek API 时，已经会通过 Server 端工具调用访问到 Search/Fetch 接口，这部分 Search/Fetch 接口调用目前未计费，并将于北京时间 2026 年 11 月 1 日 00:00 起按次收取调用费用。

接口用法与完整计费规则详见[网页搜索与抓取](/zh-cn/guides/search)。

* * *

## 扣费规则[​](#扣费规则 "扣费规则的直接链接")

模型调用费用 = token 消耗量 × 模型单价；Search 和 Fetch 按上表中的成功请求次数计费。对应的费用将直接从充值余额或赠送余额中进行扣减。 当充值余额与赠送余额同时存在时，优先扣减赠送余额。

产品价格可能发生变动，DeepSeek 保留修改价格的权利。请您依据实际用量按需充值，定期查看此页面以获知最新价格信息。
```

```text
项目文档已经按你的要求先写好了，现在**没有写任何代码**。全部需求共识如下：

## 已确认的产品定义

**训练页**
- 自定义 N 天循环（如 4 天循环，每天都是训练日，没有休息日）
- 每个动作：名称 / 组数 / 休息秒数 / 统一容量（重量 × 每组次数）
- 组块点一下变黑，自动进入休息倒计时，**锁屏也继续计**，结束震动 + 响铃
- 左右滑动或点击切天，手动推进；状态持久化；记忆上次重量次数
- **不保存训练历史**，只保留当前循环状态和上次容量

**饮食页**
- 灰条（总消耗 = BMR + 活动代谢）与蓝条（摄入）**对齐共用刻度**
- 竖虚线固定画在 `max(两者) − 500` 位置，两种大小关系用同一规则
- 主界面只展示蛋白质 / 碳水 / 脂肪总量柱状图，食物详情折叠
- 三餐 + 加餐；拍照 → DeepSeek 识别 → 确认修改 → 入账；可纯手动录入

**技术**
- 沿用好奇旅行验证过的栈：Kotlin + Compose M3 + Room，本地存储、无账号
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，官方模型名 `deepseek-flash`，Base URL `https://api.deepseek.com`，**已核实支持图像理解**

## 产出文件

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [README.md](<D:/Projects/APPdevelopment/curious-training-aid/README.md>) | 项目简介、技术栈、构建方式、隐私说明 |
| [需求说明书.md](<D:/Projects/APPdevelopment/curious-training-aid/docs/需求说明书.md>) | 完整规格：数据模型、界面规则、验收标准、v1 不做清单、未来升级预留 |

文档里还记录了两个从好奇旅行学到避免再犯的坑：**补上 Gradle wrapper**、**构建时显式设 JAVA_HOME**，另外确认了 DeepSeek 视觉接口格式要在实现前核对官方 vision 指南。
```

```text
176:         scaleY = scale
177:     }
178: }
179: 
180: /**
181:  * 按压缩放 + 点击二合一：点下去缩到 0.97，松手触发 onClick。
182:  * 给自绘的可点元素（导航项、可折叠卡片头等）用，代替裸 clickable。
183:  */
184: @Composable
185: fun Modifier.pressScaleClickable(
186:     enabled: Boolean = true,
187:     onClick: () -> Unit,
188: ): Modifier {
189:     val source = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
190:     val pressed by source.collectIsPressedAsState()
191:     val scale by animateFloatAsState(
192:         targetValue = if (pressed) 0.97f else 1f,
193:         animationSpec = Motion.press,
194:         label = "pressScale",
195:     )
196:     return this
197:         .graphicsLayer {
198:             scaleX = scale
199:             scaleY = scale
200:         }
201:         .clickable(
202:             interactionSource = source,
203:             indication = null,
204:             enabled = enabled,
205:             onClick = onClick,
206:         )
207: }
208: 
209: /**
210:  * 键盘友好输入框：聚焦时（键盘开着）再点它一下会收起键盘、退出输入模式；
211:  * 其余行为与 OutlinedTextField 一致。全 App 所有可输入框统一用它。
212:  */
213: @OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
214: @Composable
215: fun KeyboardGuardTextField(
216:     value: String,
217:     onValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
218:     modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
219:     enabled: Boolean = true,
220:     readOnly: Boolean = false,
221:     singleLine: Boolean = false,
222:     maxLines: Int = if (singleLine) 1 else Int.MAX_VALUE,
223:     label: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
224:     placeholder: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
225:     shape: Shape = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.shape,
226:     visualTransformation: VisualTransformation = VisualTransformation.None,
227:     trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
228: ) {
229:     var focused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
230:     val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
231:     val kb = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
232:     val bringIntoViewRequester = remember { BringIntoViewRequester() }
233:     val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
234: 
235:     Box(modifier) {
236:         OutlinedTextField(
237:             value = value,
238:             onValueChange = onValueChange,
239:             enabled = enabled,
240:             readOnly = readOnly,
241:             singleLine = singleLine,
242:             maxLines = maxLines,
243:             label = label,
244:             placeholder = placeholder,
245:             shape = shape,
246:             visualTransformation = visualTransformation,
247:             trailingIcon = trailingIcon,
248:             modifier = Modifier
249:                 .fillMaxWidth()
250:                 .bringIntoViewRequester(bringIntoViewRequester)
251:                 .onFocusChanged {
252:                     focused = it.isFocused
253:                     if (it.isFocused) {
254:                         // 键盘弹起动画约 250ms：等它把视口压短后再滚到可见；
255:                         // 分两次触发，确保最终到位
256:                         scope.launch {
257:                             delay(300)
258:                             bringIntoViewRequester.bringIntoView()
259:                             delay(400)
260:                             bringIntoViewRequester.bringIntoView()
261:                         }
262:                     }
263:                 },
264:         )
265:         // 聚焦时盖一层透明区域：再点一下 = 收起键盘退出输入
266:         if (focused) {
267:             Box(
268:                 modifier = Modifier
269:                     .matchParentSize()
270:                     .clickable(
271:                         interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
272:                         indication = null,
273:                     ) {
274:                         kb?.hide()
275:                         focusManager.clearFocus()
276:                     },
277:             )
278:         }
279:     }
280: }
281: 
282: /**
283:  * 给可滚动容器：点空白处（非输入框区域）收起键盘，避免键盘遮挡内容。
284:  * 用 clickable 而不是 pointerInput：输入框自己会消费点击，不会误触“点字段反而收键盘”。
285:  */
286: @Composable
287: fun Modifier.tapOutsideToDismissKeyboard(): Modifier {
288:     val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
289:     val kb = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
290:     return this.clickable(
291:         interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
292:         indication = null,
293:     ) {
294:         kb?.hide()
295:         focusManager.clearFocus()
296:     }
297: }
298: 
299: /**
300:  * 弹窗（缩放 + 淡入出场）。API 与 AlertDialog 基本一致，全 App 弹窗统一用它。
301:  */
302: @Composable
303: fun AnimatedAlertDialog(
304:     onDismissRequest: () -> Unit,
305:     title: @Composable () -> Unit,
306:     text: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
307:     confirmButton: @Composable () -> Unit,
308:     dismissButton: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
309: ) {
310:     Dialog(onDismissRequest = onDismissRequest) {
311:         val offsetY = remember { Animatable(1200f) }
312:         val alpha = remember { Animatable(0f) }
313:         LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
314:             launch { offsetY.animateTo(0f, Motion.pageSlideIn) }
315:             launch { alpha.animateTo(1f, Motion.fadeIn) }
316:         }
317:         Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
318:             Surface(
319:                 shape = RoundedCornerShape(28.dp),
320:                 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
321:                 tonalElevation = 6.dp,
322:                 modifier = Modifier
323:                     .padding(horizontal = 24.dp)
324:                     .graphicsLayer {
325:                         translationY = offsetY.value
326:                         this.alpha = alpha.value
327:                     },
328:             ) {
329:                 Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(24.dp)) {
330:                     ProvideTextStyle(MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall) { title() }
331:                     if (text != null) {
332:                         Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
333:                         ProvideTextStyle(MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium) { text() }
334:                     }
335:                     Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
336:                     Row(
337:                         Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
338:                         horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End,
339:                         verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
340:                     ) {
341:                         dismissButton?.invoke()
342:                         confirmButton()
343:                     }
344:                 }
345:             }
346:         }
347:     }
348: }
349: 
350: /** 加载态「三点呼吸」动画（AI 正在规划/修改时用） */
351: @Composable
352: fun ThinkingDots(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
353:     val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "thinking")
354:     Row(
355:         modifier,
356:         horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
357:         verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
358:     ) {
359:         repeat(3) { i ->
360:             val alpha by transition.animateFloat(
361:                 initialValue = 0.25f,
362:                 targetValue = 1f,
363:                 animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
364:                     animation = tween(360, delayMillis = i * 120),
365:                     repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse,
366:                 ),
367:                 label = "dot$i",
368:             )
369:             Box(
370:                 Modifier
371:                     .size(6.dp)
372:                     .clip(CircleShape)
373:                     .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.copy(alpha = alpha)),
374:             )
375:         }
376:     }
377: }

</content>
```

```text
<skill_instructions>
# Diagnosing Bugs

A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.

When exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.

## Redact

This skill has you show commands, outputs and captured artifacts. **Redact every secret first**: write `<REDACTED>` in its place. Build loops against env vars, so the credential stays in the environment rather than in what you show. Captured artifacts carry auth headers: quote only the lines that carry the signal.

If the redacted output is not enough to diagnose the bug, say so and ask the user.

## Phase 1: Build a feedback loop

**This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug (one that goes red on _this_ bug), you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.

Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**

### Ways to construct one, in roughly this order

1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug: unit, integration, e2e.
2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) that drives the UI and asserts on DOM/console/network.
5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.

Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.

### Tighten the loop

Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:

- Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
- Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
- Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)

A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight, a debugging superpower.

### Non-deterministic bugs

The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100脳, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not, so keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.

### When you genuinely cannot build a loop

Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a redacted captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.

### Completion criterion: a tight loop that goes red
```

```text
<skill_content name="diagnosing-bugs">
<skill_resources>
Base directory for this skill: [用户目录]\.dsh\skills\diagnosing-bugs
Resolve relative paths mentioned by this skill against the base directory before using them. Load referenced resources only as needed.
</skill_resources>

<skill_instructions>
# Diagnosing Bugs

A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.

When exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.

## Redact

This skill has you show commands, outputs and captured artifacts. **Redact every secret first**: write `<REDACTED>` in its place. Build loops against env vars, so the credential stays in the environment rather than in what you show. Captured artifacts carry auth headers: quote only the lines that carry the signal.

If the redacted output is not enough to diagnose the bug, say so and ask the user.

## Phase 1: Build a feedback loop

**This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug (one that goes red on _this_ bug), you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.

Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**

### Ways to construct one, in roughly this order

1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug: unit, integration, e2e.
2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) that drives the UI and asserts on DOM/console/network.
5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.

Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.

### Tighten the loop

Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:

- Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
- Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
- Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)

A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight, a debugging superpower.

### Non-deterministic bugs

The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100脳, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not, so keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.

### When you genuinely cannot build a loop

Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a redacted captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.

### Completion criterion: a tight loop that goes red

Phase 1 is done when the loop is **tight** and **red-capable**: you can name **one command** (a script path, a test invocation, a curl) that you have **already run at least once** (show the invocation and its output, redacted), and that is:

- [ ] **Red-capable**: it drives the actual bug code path and asserts the **user's exact symptom**, so it can go red on this bug and green once fixed. Not "runs without erroring"; it must be able to _catch this specific bug_.
- [ ] **Deterministic**: same verdict every run (flaky bugs: a pinned, high reproduction rate, per above).
- [ ] **Fast**: seconds, not minutes.
- [ ] **Agent-runnable**: you can run it unattended; a human in the loop only via `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh`.

If you catch yourself reading code to build a theory before this command exists, **stop: jumping straight to a hypothesis is the exact failure this skill prevents.** No red-capable command, no Phase 2.

## Phase 2: Reproduce + minimise

Run the loop. Watch it go red as the bug appears.

Confirm:

- [ ] The loop produces the failure mode the **user** described, not a different failure that happens to be nearby. Wrong bug = wrong fix.
- [ ] The failure is reproducible across multiple runs (or, for non-deterministic bugs, reproducible at a high enough rate to debug against).
- [ ] You have captured the exact symptom (error message, wrong output, slow timing) so later phases can verify the fix actually addresses it.

### Minimise

Once it's red, shrink the repro to the **smallest scenario that still goes red**. Cut inputs, callers, config, data, and steps **one at a time**, re-running the loop after each cut, and keep only what's load-bearing for the failure.

Why bother: a minimal repro shrinks the hypothesis space in Phase 3 (fewer moving parts left to suspect) and becomes the clean regression test in Phase 5.

Done when **every remaining element is load-bearing**: removing any one of them makes the loop go green.

Do not proceed until you have reproduced **and** minimised.

## Phase 3: Hypothesise

Generate **3鈥? ranked hypotheses** before testing any of them. Single-hypothesis generation anchors on the first plausible idea.

Each hypothesis must be **falsifiable**: state the prediction it makes.

> Format: "If <X> is the cause, then <changing Y> will make the bug disappear / <changing Z> will make it worse."

If you cannot state the prediction, the hypothesis is a vibe: discard or sharpen it.

**Show the ranked list to the user before testing.** They often have domain knowledge that re-ranks instantly ("we just deployed a change to #3"), or know hypotheses they've already ruled out. Cheap checkpoint, big time saver. Don't block on it; proceed with your ranking if the user is AFK.

## Phase 4: Instrument

Each probe must map to a specific prediction from Phase 3. **Change one variable at a time.**

Tool preference:

1. **Debugger / REPL inspection** if the env supports it. One breakpoint beats ten logs.
2. **Targeted logs** at the boundaries that distinguish hypotheses.
3. Never "log everything and grep".

**Tag every debug log** with a unique prefix, e.g. `[DEBUG-a4f2]`. Cleanup at the end becomes a single grep. Untagged logs survive; tagged logs die.

**Perf branch.** For performance regressions, logs are usually wrong. Instead: establish a baseline measurement (timing harness, `performance.now()`, profiler, query plan), then bisect. Measure first, fix second.

## Phase 5: Fix + regression test

Write the regression test **before the fix**, but only if there is a **correct seam** for it.

A correct seam is one where the test exercises the **real bug pattern** as it occurs at the call site. If the only available seam is too shallow (single-caller test when the bug needs multiple callers, unit test that can't replicate the chain that triggered the bug), a regression test there gives false confidence.

**If no correct seam exists, that itself is the finding.** Note it. The codebase architecture is preventing the bug from being locked down. Flag this for the next phase.

If a correct seam exists:

1. Turn the minimised repro into a failing test at that seam.
2. Watch it fail.
3. Apply the fix.
4. Watch it pass.
5. Re-run the Phase 1 feedback loop against the original (un-minimised) scenario.

## Phase 6: Cleanup

Required before declaring done:

- [ ] Original repro no longer reproduces (re-run the Phase 1 loop)
- [ ] Regression test passes (or absence of seam is documented)
- [ ] All `[DEBUG-...]` instrumentation removed (`grep` the prefix)
- [ ] Throwaway prototypes deleted (or moved to a clearly-marked debug location)
- [ ] The hypothesis that turned out correct is stated in the commit / PR message, so the next debugger learns
</skill_instructions>
</skill_content>
```

```text
# Diagnosing Bugs

A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.

When exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.

## Redact

This skill has you show commands, outputs and captured artifacts. **Redact every secret first**: write `<REDACTED>` in its place. Build loops against env vars, so the credential stays in the environment rather than in what you show. Captured artifacts carry auth headers: quote only the lines that carry the signal.

If the redacted output is not enough to diagnose the bug, say so and ask the user.

## Phase 1: Build a feedback loop

**This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug (one that goes red on _this_ bug), you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.

Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**

### Ways to construct one, in roughly this order

1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug: unit, integration, e2e.
2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) that drives the UI and asserts on DOM/console/network.
5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.

Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.

### Tighten the loop

Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:

- Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
- Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
- Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)

A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight, a debugging superpower.

### Non-deterministic bugs

The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100脳, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not, so keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.

### When you genuinely cannot build a loop

Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a redacted captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.
```

31: class DeepSeekClient {

33:     suspend fun testConnection(config: ApiConfig): Result<String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {

51:         }.onFailure { throw it.toAiException() }

53: 
54:     suspend fun analyzeFood(
55:         config: ApiConfig,
56:         imageBase64: String,
57:         mime: String,
58:     ): Result<List<FoodDraft>> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
59:         runCatching {

62:                 put("model", config.model)

86:                                                 }

90:                                 }
91:                             )
92:                         }
93:                     )
94:                 )
95:             }
96:             val content = postChatCompletions(config, body)
97:             parseFoods(content)
98:         }.onFailure { throw it.toAiException() }
99:     }
100:

102:         if (!config.isConfigured) throw AiException("请先在设置里填写 API Key")
103:     }

105:     private fun postChatCompletions(config: ApiConfig, body: JSONObject): String {
106:         val endpoint = config.baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
107:         val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
108:             requestMethod = "POST"
109:             connectTimeout = 15_000
110:             readTimeout = 120_000
111:             doOutput = true
112:             setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
113:             setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer [凭据已脱敏]
114:         }
115:         try {
116:             connection.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toString().toByteArray()) }
117:             val code = connection.responseCode
118:             val stream: InputStream? = if (code in 200..299) {
119:                 connection.inputStream
120:             } else {
121:                 connection.errorStream
122:             }
123:             val text = stream?.bufferedReader()?.use { reader -> reader.readText() } ?: ""
124:             if (code !in 200..299) {
125:                 throw AiException(httpErrorMessage(code, text))
126:             }
127:             val json = JSONObject(text)
128:             val choices = json.optJSONArray("choices")
129:                 ?: throw AiException("模型返回格式异常（没有 choices）")
130:             if (choices.length() == 0) throw AiException("模型没有返回内容")
131:             choices.getJSONObject(0).optJSONObject("message")?.optString("content")?.let {
132:                 if (it.isNotBlank()) return it
133:             }
134:             throw AiException("模型返回内容为空")
135:         } finally {
136:             connection.disconnect()
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:     private fun httpErrorMessage(code: Int, body: String): String {
141:         val snippet = body.take(160).replace("\n", " ")
142:         return when (code) {
143:             401, 403 -> "API Key 无效或无权限（HTTP $code）：$snippet"
144:             404 -> "接口地址或模型名不存在（HTTP 404）：$snippet"
145:             429 -> "请求太频繁或额度不足（HTTP 429）：$snippet"
146:             in 500..599 -> "服务器繁忙（HTTP $code），稍后重试：$snippet"
147:             else -> "请求失败（HTTP $code）：$snippet"
148:         }
149:     }
150: 
151:     /** 从模型输出里抠出 JSON（可能带 ``` 围栏或解释文字） */
152:     private fun parseFoods(content: String): List<FoodDraft> {
153:         val start = content.indexOf('{')
154:         val end = content.lastIndexOf('}')
155:         if (start < 0 || end <= start) throw AiException("没识别到食物，请换个角度重拍")
156:         val json = try {
157:             JSONObject(content.substring(start, end + 1))
158:         } catch (e: Exception) {
159:             throw AiException("解析识别结果失败：${content.take(60)}")
160:         }
161:         val foods = json.optJSONArray("foods") ?: JSONArray()
162:         val list = mutableListOf<FoodDraft>()
163:         for (i in 0 until foods.length()) {
164:             val item = foods.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
165:             val name = item.optString("name").trim()
166:             if (name.isBlank()) continue
167:             list += FoodDraft(
168:                 name = name,
169:                 portion = item.optString("portion").trim().ifBlank { "1 份" },
170:                 kcal = item.optDouble("kcal", 0.0).toFloat().coerceAtLeast(0f),
171:                 protein = item.optDouble("protein", 0.0).toFloat().coerceAtLeast(0f),
172:                 fat = item.optDouble("fat", 0.0).toFloat().coerceAtLeast(0f),
173:                 carbs = item.optDouble("carbs", 0.0).toFloat().coerceAtLeast(0f),
174:             )
175:         }
176:         if (list.isEmpty()) throw AiException("没识别到食物，请换个角度重拍")
177:         return list
178:     }
179: 
180:     private fun Throwable.toAiException(): AiException = when (this) {
181:         is AiException -> this
182:         is java.net.SocketTimeoutException -> AiException("网络超时，请检查网络后重试")
183:         is java.net.UnknownHostException -> AiException("无法连接服务器，请检查网络和接口地址")
184:         else -> AiException("识别失败：${message ?: "未知错误"}")
185:     }

```text
1: package com.haoqi.training.timer
2: 
3: import android.app.Notification
4: import android.app.NotificationChannel
5: import android.app.NotificationManager
6: import android.app.PendingIntent
7: import android.app.Service
8: import android.content.Context
9: import android.content.Intent
10: import android.media.AudioAttributes
11: import android.media.Ringtone
12: import android.media.RingtoneManager
13: import android.os.Build
14: import android.os.Handler
15: import android.os.IBinder
16: import android.os.Looper
17: import android.os.PowerManager
18: import android.os.SystemClock
19: import android.os.VibrationEffect
20: import android.os.Vibrator
21: import android.os.VibratorManager
22: import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
23: import androidx.core.app.ServiceCompat
24: import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
25: import com.haoqi.training.MainActivity
26: import com.haoqi.training.R
27: 
28: /**
29:  * 组间休息倒计时前台服务：
30:  *  - 前台服务 + 通知栏倒计时，锁屏/切后台继续跑
31:  *  - 计时结束震动 + 响铃（走闹钟音量通道），并弹「休息结束」通知
32:  *  - 通知栏可直接「跳过休息」
33:  */
34: class RestTimerService : Service() {
35: 
36:     private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
37:     private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null
38:     private var alertRingtone: Ringtone? = null
39:     private var endAtElapsed = 0L
40:     private var label = "休息"
41:     private var totalSeconds = 0
42:     private var lastShownSeconds = -1
43: 
44:     private val tickRunnable = object : Runnable {
45:         override fun run() {
46:             val remaining = ((endAtElapsed - SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()) / 1000L).coerceAtLeast(0L).toInt()
47:             if (remaining <= 0) {
48:                 finishRest()
49:                 return
50:             }
51:             if (remaining != lastShownSeconds) {
52:                 lastShownSeconds = remaining
53:                 notifyOngoing(remaining)
54:             }
55:             handler.postDelayed(this, 200L)
56:         }
57:     }
58: 
59:     override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null
60: 
61:     override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
62:         when (intent?.action) {
63:             ACTION_START -> {
64:                 val seconds = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_SECONDS, 60).coerceIn(0, MAX_SECONDS)
65:                 label = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_LABEL) ?: "休息"
66:                 if (seconds <= 0) {
67:                     stopSelf()
68:                     return START_NOT_STICKY
69:                 }
70:                 totalSeconds = seconds
71:                 endAtElapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + seconds * 1000L
72:                 lastShownSeconds = -1
73:                 acquireWakeLock(seconds)
74:                 startForeground(NOTIF_ID, buildOngoing(seconds))
75:                 handler.removeCallbacks(tickRunnable)
76:                 handler.post(tickRunnable)
77:             }
78: 
79:             ACTION_SKIP -> {
80:                 handler.removeCallbacks(tickRunnable)
81:                 stopAlertSound()
82:                 releaseWakeLock()
83:                 stopForegroundQuietly()
84:                 stopSelf()
85:             }
86:         }
87:         return START_NOT_STICKY
88:     }
89: 
90:     private fun finishRest() {
91:         handler.removeCallbacks(tickRunnable)
92:         releaseWakeLock()
93:         vibrateAlert()
94:         playAlertSound()
95:         val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
96:         manager.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildFinished())
97:         stopForegroundQuietly()
98:         stopSelf()
99:     }
100: 
101:     private fun notifyOngoing(remaining: Int) {
102:         val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
103:         manager.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildOngoing(remaining))
104:     }
105: 
106:     private fun buildOngoing(remaining: Int): Notification {
107:         val skipIntent = PendingIntent.getService(
108:             this,
109:             REQUEST_SKIP,
110:             Intent(this, RestTimerService::class.java).setAction(ACTION_SKIP),
111:             PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
112:         )
113:         return NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
114:             .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_notification)
115:             .setContentTitle("休息中 · $label")
116:             .setContentText("剩余 ${formatDuration(remaining)}")
117:             .setOngoing(true)
118:             .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
119:             .setSilent(true)
120:             .setContentIntent(openAppIntent())
121:             .addAction(0, "跳过休息", skipIntent)
122:             .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_STOPWATCH)
123:             .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_LOW)
124:             .build()
125:     }
126: 
127:     private fun buildFinished(): Notification =
128:         NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
129:             .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_notification)
130:             .setContentTitle("休息结束，开始下一组")
131:             .setContentText(label)
132:             .setAutoCancel(true)
133:             .setContentIntent(openAppIntent())
134:             .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_REMINDER)
135:             .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_HIGH)
136:             .build()
137: 
138:     private fun openAppIntent(): PendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
139:         this,
140:         REQUEST_OPEN,
141:         Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
142:             flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
143:         },
144:         PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
145:     )
146: 
147:     private fun acquireWakeLock(seconds: Int) {
148:         releaseWakeLock()
149:         val powerManager = getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as PowerManager
150:         wakeLock = powerManager.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "CuriousTraining:RestTimer").apply {
151:             setReferenceCounted(false)
152:             acquire((seconds + 60) * 1000L)
153:         }
154:     }
155: 
156:     private fun releaseWakeLock() {
157:         wakeLock?.let { if (it.isHeld) it.release() }
158:         wakeLock = null
159:     }
160: 
161:     private fun vibrateAlert() {
162:         val vibrator = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
163:             (getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_MANAGER_SERVICE) as VibratorManager).defaultVibrator
164:         } else {
165:             @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
166:             getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as Vibrator
167:         }
168:         val pattern = longArrayOf(0, 500, 200, 500, 200, 500, 200, 500)
169:         vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createWaveform(pattern, -1))
170:     }
171: 
172:     private fun playAlertSound() {
173:         stopAlertSound()
174:         val alarmUri = RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_ALARM)
175:             ?: RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_NOTIFICATION)
176:             ?: return
177:         alertRingtone = RingtoneManager.getRingtone(this, alarmUri)?.apply {
178:             audioAttributes = AudioAttributes.Builder()
179:                 .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM)
180:                 .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
181:                 .build()
182:             play()
183:         }
184:         handler.postDelayed({ stopAlertSound() }, ALERT_SOUND_MS)
185:     }
186: 
187:     private fun stopAlertSound() {
188:         alertRingtone?.stop()
189:         alertRingtone = null
190:     }
191: 
192:     private fun stopForegroundQuietly() {
193:         ServiceCompat.stopForeground(this, ServiceCompat.STOP_FOREGROUND_DETACH)
194:     }
195: 
196:     override fun onDestroy() {
197:         handler.removeCallbacks(tickRunnable)
198:         stopAlertSound()
199:         releaseWakeLock()
200:         super.onDestroy()
201:     }
202: 
203:     companion object {
204:         private const val CHANNEL_ID = "rest_timer"
205:         private const val CHANNEL_NAME = "休息计时"
206:         private const val NOTIF_ID = 1001
207:         private const val REQUEST_SKIP = 11
208:         private const val REQUEST_OPEN = 12
209:         private const val EXTRA_SECONDS = "seconds"
210:         private const val EXTRA_LABEL = "label"
211:         private const val MAX_SECONDS = 3600
212:         private const val ALERT_SOUND_MS = 6000L
213:         const val ACTION_START = "com.haoqi.training.action.REST_START"
214:         const val ACTION_SKIP = "com.haoqi.training.action.REST_SKIP"
215: 
216:         fun start(context: Context, seconds: Int, label: String) {
217:             createChannel(context)
218:             val intent = Intent(context, RestTimerService::class.java).apply {
219:                 action = ACTION_START
220:                 putExtra(EXTRA_SECONDS, seconds)
221:                 putExtra(EXTRA_LABEL, label)
222:             }
223:             ContextCompat.startForegroundService(context, intent)
224:         }
225: 
226:         fun skip(context: Context) {
227:             context.startService(
228:                 Intent(context, RestTimerService::class.java).setAction(ACTION_SKIP)
229:             )
230:         }
231: 
232:         fun createChannel(context: Context) {
233:             if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return
234:             val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
235:             if (manager.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID) != null) return
236:             val channel = NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, CHANNEL_NAME, NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW).apply {
237:                 description = "组间休息倒计时与结束提醒"
238:                 setSound(null, null)
239:                 enableVibration(false)
240:             }
241:             manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
242:         }
243: 
244:         private fun formatDuration(seconds: Int): String {
245:             val minutes = seconds / 60
246:             val secs = seconds % 60
247:             return if (minutes > 0) "${minutes}分${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}秒" else "${secs}秒"
248:         }
249:     }
250: }
```

```text
1: package com.haoqi.training.data.repo
2: 
3: import androidx.room.withTransaction
4: import com.haoqi.training.data.db.AppDatabase
5: import com.haoqi.training.data.db.ExerciseEntity
6: import com.haoqi.training.data.db.FoodEntryEntity
7: import com.haoqi.training.data.db.PlanDayEntity
8: import com.haoqi.training.data.db.PlanEntity
9: import com.haoqi.training.data.db.ProfileEntity
10: import com.haoqi.training.data.db.SetStateEntity
11: import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
12: 
13: class TrainingRepository(private val db: AppDatabase) {
14: 
15:     private val dao = db.trainingDao()
16: 
17:     val planFlow: Flow<PlanEntity?> = dao.observePlan()
18:     val daysFlow: Flow<List<PlanDayEntity>> = dao.observeDays()
19:     val exercisesFlow: Flow<List<ExerciseEntity>> = dao.observeExercises()
20:     val setStatesFlow: Flow<List<SetStateEntity>> = dao.observeSetStates()
21: 
22:     /** 首次启动时建一份默认计划（1 天、无动作），用户自己加。 */
23:     suspend fun ensureSeeded() = db.withTransaction {
24:         if (dao.getPlan() == null) {
25:             dao.insertPlan(PlanEntity(id = 1, dayCount = 1))
26:             dao.insertDay(PlanDayEntity(planId = 1, dayIndex = 1))
27:         }
28:     }
29: 
30:     /** 在末尾新增一天。 */
31:     suspend fun addDay() = db.withTransaction {
32:         val dayCount = dao.getPlan()?.dayCount ?: 1
33:         dao.insertDay(PlanDayEntity(planId = 1, dayIndex = dayCount + 1))
34:         renumberDaysLocked()
35:     }
36: 
37:     suspend fun removeDay(dayId: Long) = db.withTransaction {
38:         val remaining = dao.getDays().filterNot { it.id == dayId }
39:         dao.deleteDay(dayId)
40:         if (remaining.isEmpty()) {
41:             // 至少保留一天
42:             dao.insertDay(PlanDayEntity(planId = 1, dayIndex = 1))
43:         }
44:         renumberDaysLocked()
45:     }
46: 
47:     /** 新增或更新动作（id = 0 视为新增）。组数变化时同步创建/清理组状态。 */
48:     suspend fun saveExercise(exercise: ExerciseEntity): Long = db.withTransaction {
49:         if (exercise.id == 0L) {
50:             val orderIndex = (dao.getExercisesOfDay(exercise.dayId).maxOfOrNull { it.orderIndex } ?: -1) + 1
51:             val id = dao.insertExercise(exercise.copy(orderIndex = orderIndex))
52:             dao.insertSets(
53:                 (0 until exercise.setCount).map { SetStateEntity(exerciseId = id, setIndex = it) }
54:             )
55:             id
56:         } else {
57:             dao.updateExercise(exercise)
58:             syncSetCountLocked(exercise)
59:             exercise.id
60:         }
61:     }
62: 
63:     suspend fun deleteExercise(exercise: ExerciseEntity) = db.withTransaction {
64:         dao.deleteExercise(exercise)
65:     }
66: 
67:     /** 点一下组块：切换该组完成状态。 */
68:     suspend fun setSetDone(exerciseId: Long, setIndex: Int, done: Boolean) = db.withTransaction {
69:         dao.findSet(exerciseId, setIndex)?.let { dao.updateSet(it.copy(done = done)) }
70:     }
71: 
72:     suspend fun setDayCompleted(dayId: Long, completed: Boolean) = db.withTransaction {
73:         dao.setDayCompleted(dayId, completed)
74:     }
75: 
76:     private suspend fun syncSetCountLocked(exercise: ExerciseEntity) {
77:         val existing = dao.getSets(exercise.id)
78:         when {
79:             existing.size < exercise.setCount -> dao.insertSets(
80:                 (existing.size until exercise.setCount).map {
81:                     SetStateEntity(exerciseId = exercise.id, setIndex = it)
82:                 }
83:             )
84: 
85:             existing.size > exercise.setCount -> dao.deleteSetsFrom(exercise.id, exercise.setCount)
86:         }
87:     }
88: 
89:     /** 删除/新增天后，把 dayIndex 重排成连续的 1..N，并同步计划天数。 */
90:     private suspend fun renumberDaysLocked() {
91:         val days = dao.getDays()
92:         days.forEachIndexed { index, day ->
93:             if (day.dayIndex != index + 1) dao.updateDay(day.copy(dayIndex = index + 1))
94:         }
95:         dao.updateDayCount(days.size.coerceAtLeast(1))
96:     }
97: }
98: 
99: class DietRepository(db: AppDatabase) {
100: 
101:     private val dao = db.dietDao()
102: 
103:     fun observeEntries(date: String): Flow<List<FoodEntryEntity>> = dao.observeEntries(date)
104: 
105:     suspend fun addEntry(entry: FoodEntryEntity): Long = dao.insertEntry(entry)
106: 
107:     suspend fun updateEntry(entry: FoodEntryEntity) = dao.updateEntry(entry)
108: 
109:     suspend fun deleteEntry(entry: FoodEntryEntity) = dao.deleteEntry(entry)
110: }
111: 
112: class ProfileRepository(db: AppDatabase) {
113: 
114:     private val dao = db.profileDao()
115: 
116:     val profileFlow: Flow<ProfileEntity?> = dao.observeProfile()
117: 
118:     suspend fun ensureDefault() {
119:         if (dao.getProfile() == null) dao.upsertProfile(ProfileEntity())
120:     }
121: 
122:     suspend fun saveProfile(profile: ProfileEntity) = dao.upsertProfile(profile)
123: }
```

```text
9: /** 把用户选的照片压到适合发给视觉模型的尺寸，省流量也省 token。 */
10: object ImageCompressor {
11: 
12:     fun loadJpegBytes(
13:         context: Context,
14:         uri: Uri,
15:         maxDimension: Int = 1024,
16:         quality: Int = 80,
17:     ): ByteArray? {
18:         val resolver = context.contentResolver
19:         val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }

21:         if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0) return null
22: 
23:         val options = BitmapFactory.Options().apply {
24:             inSampleSize = calculateInSampleSize(bounds.outWidth, bounds.outHeight, maxDimension)
25:         }
26:         val bitmap = resolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use {
27:             BitmapFactory.decodeStream(it, null, options)
28:         } ?: return null
29: 
30:         val scaled = scaleDown(bitmap, maxDimension)
31:         if (scaled !== bitmap) bitmap.recycle()
32:         return ByteArrayOutputStream().use { out ->
33:             scaled.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, quality, out)
34:             scaled.recycle()
35:             out.toByteArray()
36:         }
37:     }
38: 
39:     fun mimeTypeOf(context: Context, uri: Uri): String =
40:         context.contentResolver.getType(uri) ?: "image/jpeg"
41: 
42:     private fun calculateInSampleSize(width: Int, height: Int, maxDimension: Int): Int {
43:         var sample = 1
44:         var longest = maxOf(width, height)
45:         while (longest / 2 >= maxDimension) {
46:             longest /= 2
47:             sample *= 2
48:         }
49:         return sample
50:     }
51: 
52:     private fun scaleDown(bitmap: Bitmap, maxDimension: Int): Bitmap {
53:         val longest = maxOf(bitmap.width, bitmap.height)
54:         if (longest <= maxDimension) return bitmap
55:         val scale = maxDimension.toFloat() / longest
56:         val width = (bitmap.width * scale).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
57:         val height = (bitmap.height * scale).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
58:         return Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bitmap, width, height, true)
59:     }
60: }
```

````text
# 图像理解

`deepseek-flash` 模型支持在文本之外输入图片，你可以让模型描述图片、识别截图中的文字、分析图表等。旧模型名 `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 仍可调用，但该模型已下线，其请求同样由最新的 Flash 模型承接。

支持的图片格式：**JPEG、PNG、GIF、WebP**。格式由文件实际内容判断，而非文件名或声明的 MIME 类型。

* * *

## 传入图片[​](#传入图片 "传入图片的直接链接")

共有三种方式向模型提供图片，均使用标准的 OpenAI 兼容对话补全格式，即 `content` 为一个块（block）数组，而非纯字符串。同样的三种方式也适用于 [Responses API](/zh-cn/guides/responses_api#image-input)，图片以 `input_image` 内容块承载。

以下示例的 `base_url` 为 `https://api.deepseek.com`。

### 1\. Base64 编码图片（内联）[​](#1-base64-编码图片内联 "1. Base64 编码图片（内联）的直接链接")

将图片编码后以 `data:` URL 的形式直接嵌入请求。这是本地文件最简单的方式。编码后的数据会计入 **48 MiB** 请求体大小限制（见 [限制](#limits)）。

```
import base64from openai import OpenAIclient = OpenAI(api_key=[凭据已脱敏], base_url="https://api.deepseek.com")with open("image.jpg", "rb") as f:    b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")response = client.chat.completions.create(    model="deepseek-flash",    messages=[        {            "role": "user",            "content": [                {"type": "text", "text": "这张图片里有什么？"},                {                    "type": "image_url",                    "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{b64}"},                },            ],        },    ],)print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

```
curl https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -H "Authorization: [凭据已脱敏] <DeepSeek API Key>" \  -d '{    "model": "deepseek-flash",    "messages": [      {        "role": "user",        "content": [          {"type": "text", "text": "这张图片里有什么？"},          {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64,<BASE64_DATA>"}}        ]      }    ]  }'
```

### 2\. 外部图片 URL[​](#2-外部图片-url "2. 外部图片 URL的直接链接")

传入一个可公开访问的 `http(s)` 链接，模型会自动下载图片。URL 长度最多 **8192 个字符**，图片文件最大 **32 MiB**，且需在 **60 秒**内完成下载。如果链接超长，请改用 base64 data URL 或 Files API。

```
response = client.chat.completions.create(    model="deepseek-flash",    messages=[        {            "role": "user",            "content": [                {"type": "text", "text": "描述一下这张图片。"},                {                    "type": "image_url",                    "image_url": {"url": "https://example.com/image.jpg"},                },            ],        },    ],)print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

### 3\. 引用通过 Files API 上传的文件[​](#3-引用通过-files-api-上传的文件 "3. 引用通过 Files API 上传的文件的直接链接")

通过 [Files API](/zh-cn/guides/files_api) 上传一次图片，之后在请求中用其 `file_id` 引用。当你需要在多个请求中复用同一张图片，或图片会让请求体超过 48 MiB 内联限制时，这是最佳选择。与内联图片不同，通过 Files API `file_id` 引用的图片最大可达 64 MiB，且不受 32 MiB 单图检查限制。

使用 `file` 内容块，填入返回的 `file_id`（形如 `file-api-...`）：

```
response = client.chat.completions.create(    model="deepseek-flash",    messages=[        {            "role": "user",            "content": [                {"type": "text", "text": "这张图片里有什么？"},                {"type": "file", "file_id": "file-api-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"},            ],        },    ],)print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

此外，`file` 块也可以通过 `file_data` 以 base64 形式内联携带图片（`file_data` 与 `file_id` 二者互斥）：

```
{  "type": "file",  "file_data": "data:image/jpeg;base64,<BASE64_DATA>",  "filename": "image.jpg"}
```

* * *

## 细节级别（Detail Level）[​](#细节级别detail-level "细节级别（Detail Level）的直接链接")

对于 `image_url` 输入，你可以选填 `detail` 字段来控制图片的处理方式：

| 取值  | 行为  |
| --- | --- |
| `low` | 推理前将图片缩放到 512×512。当不需要精细视觉细节时更快、更省 token。 |
| `high` | 保留原图。（为兼容性提供，等价于 `original`。） |
| `original` | 保留原图。 |
| `auto` | 自动选择。当前等价于 `original`。 |

```
{  "type": "image_url",  "image_url": {"url": "https://example.com/image.jpg", "detail": "low"}}
```

* * *

## 何时使用 Files API[​](#何时使用-files-api "何时使用 Files API的直接链接")

内联图片（base64 或 `file_data`）会计入 **48 MiB** 的请求体大小限制。以下情况建议使用 [Files API](/zh-cn/guides/files_api)：

-   单个请求会超过请求体大小限制。
-   图片超过 32 MiB（只有通过 Files API 才能使用）。
-   你在多个请求中引用同一张图片，希望避免每次重复上传。

* * *

## Token 用量[​](#token-usage "Token 用量的直接链接")

图片会根据其尺寸换算成 token，并与文本 token 一起计费。

在进入模型前，每张图片都会被自动缩放：

-   总像素小于约 544×544 的图片会被保持长宽比放大；
-   更大的图片会被保持长宽比缩小，缩小后的总像素约相当于 **1300×1300** 的图片。

因此，每张图片消耗的 token 数存在上限（**1024** 个）：例如 2000×2000 和 5000×5000 的图片，经缩放后消耗的 token 数是相同的。单个请求包含多张图片时，每张图片独立按同一规则计算，不存在额外的计算方式。

如需估算具体尺寸图片的 token 消耗，请使用 [Token 与用量计算](/zh-cn/quick_start/token_usage) 页面的图片 Token 计算器。

* * *

## 限制[​](#limits "限制的直接链接")

| 限制项 | 数值  |
| --- | --- |
| 支持的格式 | JPEG、PNG、GIF、WebP |
| 外部 URL 长度 | 8192 个字符 |
| 请求体大小 | 48 MiB |
| 单张图片最大大小（base64 / 外部 URL） | 32 MiB |
| 单张图片最大大小（Files API `file_id`） | 64 MiB |
| 单个请求最大图片数 | 600 |
| 单个请求图片总大小 | 不含 `file_id` 图片最多 64 MiB；包含 `file_id` 图片最高 200 MiB |
| 图片最大尺寸 | 单边最长 8192 像素；单个请求包含 15 张及以上图片时，降为单边最长 4096 像素 |

Files API 上传文件的存储与上传配额见 [Files API：限制](/zh-cn/guides/files_api#limits)。

* * *

## 使用限制[​](#使用限制 "使用限制的直接链接")

-   图片仅支持出现在 `user` 消息中。`system` 或 `assistant` 消息携带图片会返回 `400` 错误。

* * *

## 在 Anthropic API 中使用图片[​](#在-anthropic-api-中使用图片 "在 Anthropic API 中使用图片的直接链接")

除了上面的 OpenAI 兼容端点，你也可以通过 Anthropic 兼容的 `/messages` 端点发送图片（`base_url` 为 `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic`）。基础配置请参考 [Anthropic API](/zh-cn/guides/anthropic_api)。

区别在于图片内容块的结构。Anthropic 不使用 `image_url`，而是使用 `image` 块，其 `source` 对象的 `type` 为 `base64`、`url` 或 `file` 之一：

```
import anthropicclient = anthropic.Anthropic()  # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com/anthropicmessage = client.messages.create(    model="deepseek-flash",    max_tokens=1024,    messages=[        {            "role": "user",            "content": [                {"type": "text", "text": "这张图片里有什么？"},                {                    "type": "image",                    "source": {                        "type": "base64",                        "media_type": "image/jpeg",                        "data": "<BASE64_DATA>",                    },                },            ],        },    ],)print(message.content)
```

三种 `source` 变体与上面的 OpenAI 方式一一对应：

| `source.type` | 对应的 OpenAI 方式 | 说明  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base64` | Base64 编码图片 | 需要 `media_type` 字段（`image/jpeg`、`image/png`、`image/gif` 或 `image/webp`）。 |
| `url` | 外部图片 URL | 最多 8192 个字符。 |
| `file` | Files API `file_id` | 需要请求头 `anthropic-beta: files-api-2025-04-14`。 |

* * *

## 在 Responses API 中使用图片[​](#responses-api "在 Responses API 中使用图片的直接链接")

`deepseek-flash` 模型同样支持通过 OpenAI 兼容的 [Responses API](/zh-cn/guides/responses_api#image-input) 传入图片。三种传入方式（base64 data URL、外部 `http(s)` URL、Files API `file_id`）与[限制](#limits)均与上文一致，只有内容块的结构不同——图片以 `input_image` 内容块承载，可出现在 `user` / `developer` 消息或 `function_call_output` / `custom_tool_call_output` item 的 `output` 中：

```
response = client.responses.create(    model="deepseek-flash",    input=[        {            "role": "user",            "content": [                {"type": "input_text", "text": "这张图片里有什么？"},                {"type": "input_image", "image_url": "https://example.com/image.jpg", "detail": "low"},            ],        },    ],)print(response.output_text)
```

`input_image` 内容块支持 `detail` 字段，语义与上文一致（`low` / `high` / `original` / `auto`）。通过 `file_id` 传图时 `detail` 被忽略；`image_url` 与 `file_id` 互斥。

字段语义、使用限制（`system` / `assistant` 消息中的图片会返回 `400` 错误）以及工具输出中的图片，请参阅 [Responses API 指南](/zh-cn/guides/responses_api#image-input)。
````

````text
# 思考模式

DeepSeek 模型支持思考模式：在输出最终回答之前，模型会先输出一段思维链内容，以提升最终答案的准确性。

## 思考模式开关与思考强度控制[​](#思考模式开关与思考强度控制 "思考模式开关与思考强度控制的直接链接")

**

|     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|     | 控制参数（OpenAI 格式） | 控制参数（Anthropic 格式） | 控制参数（Responses API 格式） |
| 思考模式开关(1) | `{"thinking": {"type": "enabled/disabled"}}` | `{"reasoning": {"effort": "none/low/high/max"}}`  <br>(none 表示关闭思考模式) |
| 思考强度控制(2) | `{"reasoning_effort": "low/high/max"}` | `{"output_config": {"effort": "low/high/max"}}` |

**

(1) 思考模式默认打开，且 effort 默认为 `high`  
(2) 用户设置的 effort 与模型推理 effort 映射表如下：

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| 请求传入 effort | 实际映射 effort |
| minimal | low |
| low | low |
| medium | high |
| high | high |
| xhigh | high |
| max | max |
| ultra | max |

您在 OpenAI SDK 中使用 Chat Completion 设置 `thinking` 参数时，需要将 `thinking` 参数传入 `extra_body` 中：

```
response = client.chat.completions.create(  model="deepseek-flash",  # ...  reasoning_effort="high",  extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}},)
```

## 输入输出参数[​](#输入输出参数 "输入输出参数的直接链接")

思考模式不支持 `temperature`、`presence_penalty`、`frequency_penalty` 参数。请注意，为了兼容已有软件，设置参数不会报错，但也不会生效。

`top_p` 的行为因模型而异：

-   `deepseek-flash`：仅在思考模式下生效，有效取值范围为 `0.95`–`1.0`，低于 `0.95` 的取值会按 `0.95` 处理。在非思考模式下，该参数恒为 `1.0`，传入的值会被忽略。
-   `deepseek-v4-pro`：思考模式下会忽略传入值（携带 `tools` 时固定为 `0.95`，否则为 `1.0`）；非思考模式下生效。

在思考模式下，思维链内容通过 `reasoning_content` 参数返回，与 `content` 同级。在后续轮次的请求中，`reasoning_content` 是否需要回传、是否会被拼接进上下文，取决于请求是否携带 `tools` 参数：

-   若请求**携带 `tools` 参数**：历史轮次的 `reasoning_content` 均应回传给 API，并会被拼接进上下文。详见[工具调用](#tool-calls)。
-   若请求**未携带 `tools` 参数**：`reasoning_content` 无需回传；即使传入 API，也会被忽略，不会拼接进上下文。详见[多轮对话拼接](#%E5%A4%9A%E8%BD%AE%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%E6%8B%BC%E6%8E%A5)。

## 多轮对话拼接[​](#多轮对话拼接 "多轮对话拼接的直接链接")

在每一轮对话过程中，模型会输出思维链内容（`reasoning_content`）和最终回答（`content`）。如果请求未携带 `tools` 参数，则在下一轮对话中，之前轮输出的思维链内容不会被拼接到上下文中，如下图所示：

![](/zh-cn/img/deepseek_r1_multiround_example_cn.jpeg)

### 样例代码[​](#样例代码 "样例代码的直接链接")

下面的代码以 Python 语言为例，展示了如何访问思维链和最终回答，以及如何在多轮对话中进行上下文拼接。

-   非流式
-   流式

```
from openai import OpenAIclient = OpenAI(api_key=[凭据已脱敏], base_url="https://api.deepseek.com")# Turn 1messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "9.11 and 9.8, which is greater?"}]response = client.chat.completions.create(    model="deepseek-flash",    messages=messages,    reasoning_effort="high",    extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}},)reasoning_content = response.choices[0].message.reasoning_contentcontent = response.choices[0].message.content# Turn 2# The reasoning_content will be ignored by the APImessages.append(response.choices[0].message)messages.append({'role': 'user', 'content': "How many Rs are there in the word 'strawberry'?"})response = client.chat.completions.create(    model="deepseek-flash",    messages=messages,    reasoning_effort="high",    extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}},)# ...
```

## 工具调用[​](#tool-calls "工具调用的直接链接")

DeepSeek 模型的思考模式支持工具调用功能。模型在输出最终答案之前，可以进行多轮的思考与工具调用，以提升答案的质量。其调用模式如下图所示：

![](/zh-cn/img/thinking_with_tools.jpg)

请注意，携带了 `tools` 参数的请求，在后续所有请求中，必须完整回传 `reasoning_content` 给 API——即使该轮模型未实际进行工具调用。若您的代码中未正确回传 `reasoning_content`，API 会返回 400 报错。正确回传方法请您参考下面的样例代码。

### 样例代码[​](#样例代码-1 "样例代码的直接链接")

下面是一个简单的在思考模式下进行工具调用的样例代码：

```
import osimport jsonfrom openai import OpenAIfrom datetime import datetime# The definition of the toolstools = [    {        "type": "function",        "function": {            "name": "get_date",            "description": "Get the current date",            "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": {} },        },    },    {        "type": "function",        "function": {            "name": "get_weather",            "description": "Get weather of a location, the user should supply the location and date.",            "parameters": {                "type": "object",                "properties": {                    "location": { "type": "string", "description": "The city name" },                    "date": { "type": "string", "description": "The date in format YYYY-mm-dd" },                },                "required": ["location", "date"],            },        },    },]# The mocked version of the tool callsdef get_date_mock():    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")def get_weather_mock(location, date):    return "Cloudy 7~13°C"TOOL_CALL_MAP = {    "get_date": get_date_mock,    "get_weather": get_weather_mock,}def run_turn(turn, messages):    sub_turn = 1    while True:        response = client.chat.completions.create(            model='deepseek-flash',            messages=messages,            tools=tools,            reasoning_effort="high",            extra_body={ "thinking": { "type": "enabled" } },        )        messages.append(response.choices[0].message)        reasoning_content = response.choices[0].message.reasoning_content        content = response.choices[0].message.content        tool_calls = response.choices[0].message.tool_calls        print(f"Turn {turn}.{sub_turn}\n{reasoning_content=}\n{content=}\n{tool_calls=}")        # If there is no tool calls, then the model should get a final answer and we need to stop the loop        if tool_calls is None:            break        for tool in tool_calls:            tool_function = TOOL_CALL_MAP[tool.function.name]            tool_result = tool_function(**json.loads(tool.function.arguments))            print(f"tool result for {tool.function.name}: {tool_result}\n")            messages.append({                "role": "tool",                "tool_call_id": tool.id,                "content": tool_result,            })        sub_turn += 1    print()client = OpenAI(    api_key=[凭据已脱敏],    base_url=os.environ.get('DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL'),)# The user starts a questionturn = 1messages = [{    "role": "user",    "content": "How's the weather in Hangzhou Tomorrow",}]run_turn(turn, messages)# The user starts a new questionturn = 2messages.append({    "role": "user",    "content": "How's the weather in Guangzhou Tomorrow",})run_turn(turn, messages)
```

在 Turn 1 的每个子请求中，都携带了该 Turn 下产生的 `reasoning_content` 给 API，从而让模型继续之前的思考。`response.choices[0].message` 携带了 `assistant` 消息的所有必要字段，包括 `content`、`reasoning_content`、`tool_calls`。简单起见，可以直接用如下代码将消息 append 到 messages 结尾：
````

```text
94: @Composable

109:     }

112: /**

114:  * highlight = true 时用珊瑚橙（只给「重要且少见」的操作用，如「满意，创建旅行」）。
115:  */
116: @Composable
117: fun PrimaryButton(
118:     text: String,
119:     onClick: () -> Unit,
120:     modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
121:     enabled: Boolean = true,
122:     highlight: Boolean = false,
123: ) {
124:     val (interaction, pressModifier) = rememberPressScale()
125:     Button(

127:         enabled = enabled,
128:         interactionSource = interaction,
129:         shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
130:         colors = if (highlight) {
131:             ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
132:                 containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary,
133:                 contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSecondary,
134:             )
135:         } else {
136:             ButtonDefaults.buttonColors()
137:         },
138:         modifier = modifier
139:             .fillMaxWidth()
140:             .height(52.dp)
141:             .then(pressModifier),
142:     ) {
143:         Text(text, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge)
144:     }
145: }

147: /**
148:  * 按压缩放反馈：按住缩到 0.97，松手弹回。
149:  * 返回 (interactionSource, 缩放 modifier)——把 source 同时传给 clickable/Button 才会生效。
150:  */
151: @Composable
152: fun rememberPressScale(): Pair<MutableInteractionSource, Modifier> {
153:     val source = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
154:     val pressed by source.collectIsPressedAsState()
155:     val scale by animateFloatAsState(
156:         targetValue = if (pressed) 0.97f else 1f,
157:         animationSpec = Motion.press,
158:         label = "pressScale",
159:     )
160:     return source to Modifier.graphicsLayer {
161:         scaleX = scale
162:         scaleY = scale
163:     }
164: }
165: 
166: /** 通用按压反馈占位（InteractionSource 版本，供自定义 clickable 场景使用） */
167: @Composable
168: fun rememberPressScaleFor(source: InteractionSource): Modifier {
169:     val pressed by source.collectIsPressedAsState()
170:     val scale by animateFloatAsState(
171:         targetValue = if (pressed) 0.97f else 1f,
172:         animationSpec = Motion.press,
173:         label = "pressScale",
174:     )
175:     return Modifier.graphicsLayer {
176:         scaleX = scale
177:         scaleY = scale
178:     }
179: }
180: 
181: /**
182:  * 按压缩放 + 点击二合一：点下去缩到 0.97，松手触发 onClick。
183:  * 给自绘的可点元素（导航项、可折叠卡片头等）用，代替裸 clickable。
184:  */
185: @Composable
186: fun Modifier.pressScaleClickable(
187:     enabled: Boolean = true,
188:     onClick: () -> Unit,
189: ): Modifier {
190:     val source = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
191:     val pressed by source.collectIsPressedAsState()
192:     val scale by animateFloatAsState(
193:         targetValue = if (pressed) 0.97f else 1f,
194:         animationSpec = Motion.press,
195:         label = "pressScale",
196:     )
197:     return this
198:         .graphicsLayer {
199:             scaleX = scale
200:             scaleY = scale
201:         }
202:         .clickable(
203:             interactionSource = source,
204:             indication = null,
205:             enabled = enabled,
206:             onClick = onClick,
207:         )
208: }
209: 
210: /**
211:  * 键盘友好输入框：聚焦时（键盘开着）再点它一下会收起键盘、退出输入模式；
212:  * 其余行为与 OutlinedTextField 一致。全 App 所有可输入框统一用它。
213:  */
214: @OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
215: @Composable
216: fun KeyboardGuardTextField(
217:     value: String,
218:     onValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
219:     modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
220:     enabled: Boolean = true,
221:     readOnly: Boolean = false,
222:     singleLine: Boolean = false,
223:     maxLines: Int = if (singleLine) 1 else Int.MAX_VALUE,
224:     label: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
225:     placeholder: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
226:     shape: Shape = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.shape,
227:     visualTransformation: VisualTransformation = VisualTransformation.None,
228:     trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
229:     keyboardOptions: KeyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions.Default,
230: ) {
231:     var focused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
232:     val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
233:     val kb = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
234:     val bringIntoViewRequester = remember { BringIntoViewRequester() }
235:     val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
236: 
237:     Box(modifier) {
238:         OutlinedTextField(
239:             value = value,
240:             onValueChange = onValueChange,
241:             enabled = enabled,
242:             readOnly = readOnly,
243:             singleLine = singleLine,
244:             maxLines = maxLines,
245:             label = label,
246:             placeholder = placeholder,
247:             shape = shape,
248:             visualTransformation = visualTransformation,
249:             trailingIcon = trailingIcon,
250:             keyboardOptions = keyboardOptions,
251:             modifier = Modifier
252:                 .fillMaxWidth()
253:                 .bringIntoViewRequester(bringIntoViewRequester)
254:                 .onFocusChanged {
255:                     focused = it.isFocused
256:                     if (it.isFocused) {
257:                         // 键盘弹起动画约 250ms：等它把视口压短后再滚到可见；
258:                         // 分两次触发，确保最终到位
259:                         scope.launch {
260:                             delay(300)
261:                             bringIntoViewRequester.bringIntoView()
262:                             delay(400)
263:                             bringIntoViewRequester.bringIntoView()
264:                         }
265:                     }
266:                 },
267:         )
268:         // 聚焦时盖一层透明区域：再点一下 = 收起键盘退出输入
269:         if (focused) {
270:             Box(
271:                 modifier = Modifier
272:                     .matchParentSize()
273:                     .clickable(
274:                         interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
275:                         indication = null,
276:                     ) {
277:                         kb?.hide()
278:                         focusManager.clearFocus()
279:                     },
280:             )
281:         }
282:     }
283: }
284: 
285: /**
286:  * 给可滚动容器：点空白处（非输入框区域）收起键盘，避免键盘遮挡内容。
287:  * 用 clickable 而不是 pointerInput：输入框自己会消费点击，不会误触“点字段反而收键盘”。
288:  */
289: @Composable
290: fun Modifier.tapOutsideToDismissKeyboard(): Modifier {
291:     val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
292:     val kb = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
293:     return this.clickable(
294:         interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
295:         indication = null,
296:     ) {
297:         kb?.hide()
298:         focusManager.clearFocus()
299:     }
300: }
301: 
302: /**
303:  * 弹窗（缩放 + 淡入出场）。API 与 AlertDialog 基本一致，全 App 弹窗统一用它。
304:  */
305: @Composable
306: fun AnimatedAlertDialog(
307:     onDismissRequest: () -> Unit,
308:     title: @Composable () -> Unit,
309:     text: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
310:     confirmButton: @Composable () -> Unit,
311:     dismissButton: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
312: ) {
313:     Dialog(onDismissRequest = onDismissRequest) {
314:         val offsetY = remember { Animatable(1200f) }
315:         val alpha = remember { Animatable(0f) }
316:         LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
317:             launch { offsetY.animateTo(0f, Motion.pageSlideIn) }
318:             launch { alpha.animateTo(1f, Motion.fadeIn) }
319:         }
320:         Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
321:             Surface(
322:                 shape = RoundedCornerShape(28.dp),
323:                 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
324:                 tonalElevation = 6.dp,
325:                 modifier = Modifier
326:                     .padding(horizontal = 24.dp)
327:                     .graphicsLayer {
328:                         translationY = offsetY.value
329:                         this.alpha = alpha.value
330:                     },
331:             ) {
332:                 Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(24.dp)) {
333:                     ProvideTextStyle(MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall) { title() }
334:                     if (text != null) {
335:                         Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
336:                         ProvideTextStyle(MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium) { text() }
337:                     }
338:                     Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
339:                     Row(
340:                         Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
341:                         horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End,
342:                         verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
343:                     ) {
344:                         dismissButton?.invoke()
345:                         confirmButton()
346:                     }
347:                 }
348:             }
349:         }
350:     }
351: }
352: 
353: /** 加载态「三点呼吸」动画（AI 正在规划/修改时用） */
354: @Composable
355: fun ThinkingDots(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
356:     val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "thinking")
357:     Row(
358:         modifier,
359:         horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
360:         verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
361:     ) {
362:         repeat(3) { i ->
363:             val alpha by transition.animateFloat(
364:                 initialValue = 0.25f,
365:                 targetValue = 1f,
366:                 animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
367:                     animation = tween(360, delayMillis = i * 120),
368:                     repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse,
369:                 ),
370:                 label = "dot$i",
371:             )
372:             Box(
373:                 Modifier
374:                     .size(6.dp)
375:                     .clip(CircleShape)
376:                     .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.copy(alpha = alpha)),
377:             )
378:         }
379:     }
380: }
```

```text
<content>
1: # 好奇训练 · CuriousTrainingAid
2: 
3: 轻量健身辅助 App：训练计划执行 + 饮食记录。单机使用、无需注册，数据只存本机。
4: 
5: ## 技术栈
6: 
7: - Kotlin + Jetpack Compose（Material 3）
8: - Room（本地数据库，纯离线）
9: - 前台服务 + 通知（休息计时锁屏也能提醒）
10: - DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 图像理解（拍照识别食物营养）
11: 
12: ## 功能
13: 
14: - **训练计划**：自定义循环天数（如 4 天循环），每天独立计划；每个动作记录名称、组数、休息时间、容量（重量 × 次数）。
15: - **训练执行**：每完成一组该组方块变黑；自动开始休息倒计时，结束震动 + 响铃；左右滑动切换训练日，手动推进。
16: - **饮食记录**：基础代谢（Mifflin-St Jeor）+ 自填活动代谢 = 每日总消耗；总消耗（灰条）与摄入（蓝条）双进度条对齐比较，500 kcal 差值处画竖虚线；蛋白质/碳水/脂肪总量柱状图；三餐 + 加餐；拍照 AI 识别 → 确认修改 → 入账。
17: - **设置**：个人资料（性别/年龄/身高/体重/活动代谢）、AI 接口配置（Base URL / 模型名 / API Key，本机保存）。
18: 
19: ## 安装
20: 
21: 构建 Apk：`gradlew.bat :app:assembleRelease`，产物在 `app/build/outputs/apk/release/`。
22: 
23: 构建需要 JDK 17+（本机可用 `[用户目录]\.jdks\jbr-21.0.11`，构建时设置 `JAVA_HOME`）；Android SDK 需 platform android-34 / build-tools 34.0.0。
24: 
25: ## 隐私
26: 
27: - 训练计划、饮食记录、个人资料只存本机，不上传任何服务器；
28: - 只有你在拍照识别时，照片会发送给你配置的 AI 接口（DeepSeek）用于识别，不存你的其他数据；
29: - API Key 只保存在本机。
30: 
31: 详细需求见 [docs/需求说明书.md](docs/需求说明书.md)。

(End of file - total 31 lines)
</content>
```
